verses.text: Abakomoka kuri Adamu ni Seti, Enoshi,
Kenani, Mahalaleli, Yaredi,
Enoki, Metusela, Lameki, Nowa.
Abahungu ba Nowa ni: Shemu, Hamu na Yafeti.
Bene Yafeti ni: Gomeri, Magogi, Madayi, Yavani, Tubali, Mesheki na Tirasi.
Bene Gomeri ni: Ashikenazi, Difati na Togaruma.
Bene Yavani ni: Elisa, Tarushishi, Kitimu na Rodanimu.
Bene Hamu ni: Kushi, Egiputa, Puti na Kanani.
Bene Kushi ni: Seba, Havila, Sabuta, Rama na Sabuteka. Abahungu ba Rama ni: Sheba na Dedani.
Kushi yavyaye Nimurodi, uwo ni we yatanguye kuba umuhizi mu ntambara kw’isi.
Abakomotse kuri Egiputa ni Abaludi, Abanami, Abalehabi, Abanafutuhi,
Abapatirusi n’Abakasiluni (ari bo bakomotsweko n’Abafilisitiya) hamwe n’Abakafutori.
Kanani yavyaye Sidoni, ari we mfura yiwe, hamwe na Heti.
Kandi yakomotsweko n’Abayebusi, Abamori, Abagirugashi,
Abahiwi, Abaruki, Abasini,
Abaruvadi, Abazemari n’Abahamati.
Bene Shemu ni: Elamu, Ashuri, Arupakisade, Ludi na Aramu. Abahungu ba Aramu ni: Uzi, Huli, Geteri na Mesheki.
Arupakisade yavyaye Shela, Shela na we avyara Eberi.
Eberi yavyaye abahungu babiri: umwe yitwa Pelegi, kuko igihe yavuka abantu bari kw’isi bari bigabuyemwo ibice; uwundi bavukana yitwa Yokitani.
Yokitani yavyaye Alumodadi, Shelefu, Hazarumaveti, Yera,
Hadoramu, Uzali, Dikula,
Ebali, Abimayeli, Sheba,
Ofiru, Havila na Yobabu. Abo bose bari abahungu ba Yokitani.
Shemu, Arupakisade, Shela,
Eberi, Pelegi, Rewu,
Serugi, Nahori, Tera,
na Aburamu (ari we Aburahamu).
Bene Aburahamu ni: Isaka na Ishimayeli.
Uru ni rwo ruvyaro rwabo: Nebayoti imfura ya Ishimayeli, Kedari, Adibeyeli, Mibusamu,
Mishima, Duma, Masa, Hadadi, Tema,
Yeturi, Nafishi na Kedema. Abo ni bo bari bene Ishimayeli.
Abo Aburahamu yavyaranye na Ketura incoreke yiwe, ni Zimurani, Yokishani, Medani, Midiyani, Ishibaki na Shuwa. Bene Yokishani ni Sheba na Dedani.
Bene Midiyani ni Efa, Eferi, Hanoki, Abida na Eludaya. Urwo ni rwo ruvyaro Aburahamu yavyaranye na Ketura.
Aburahamu yavyaye Isaka. Bene Isaka ni: Esawu na Isirayeli.
Bene Esawu, ni Elifazi, Reyuweli, Yewushi, Yalamu na Kora.
Bene Elifazi, ni Temani, Omari, Zefo, Gatamu na Kenazi; Timuna na Amaleki.
Bene Reyuweli, ni Nahati, Zera, Shama na Miza.
Bene Seyiri, ni Lotani, Shobali, Zibeyoni, Ana, Dishoni, Ezeri na Dishani.
Bene Lotani, ni Hori na Homamu. Timuna yari mushiki wa Lotani.
Bene Shobali, ni Alivani, Manahati, Ebali, Shefo na Onamu. Bene Zibeyoni, ni Ayiya na Ana.
Mwene Ana, ni Dishoni. Bene Dishoni, ni Hemudani, Eshibani, Itirani na Kerani.
Bene Ezeri ni Bilihani, Zayavani na Akani. Bene Dishani, ni Uzi na Arani.
Uru ni rwo rukurikirane rw’abami batwaye mu gihugu ca Edomu, imbere y’uko Isirayeli yimika umwami n’umwe: Bela mwene Beyori, igisagara ciwe citwa Dinihaba.
Bela apfuye, asubirirwa ku ngoma na Yobabu mwene Zera yava i Bozira.
Yobabu apfuye, asubirirwa ku ngoma na Hushamu yava mu gihugu c’Abatemani.
Hushamu apfuye, asubirirwa ku ngoma na Hadadi mwene Bedadi, ari we yanesheje Abamidiyani mu gihugu ca Mowabu. Igisagara ciwe citwa Aviti.
Hadadi apfuye, asubirirwa ku ngoma na Samula yava i Masireka.
Samula apfuye, asubirirwa ku ngoma na Shawuli yava i Rehoboti hafi y’uruzi.
Shawuli apfuye, asubirirwa ku ngoma na Bayali-Hanani mwene Akibori.
Bayali-Hanani apfuye, asubirirwa ku ngoma na Hadadi. Igisagara ciwe citwa Pawu, umugore wiwe yitwa Mehetabeli, umukobwa wa Materedi, akaba n’umwuzukuru wa Mezahabu.
Hadadi na we nyene arapfa. Abakuru b’imiryango y’Abanyedomu bari aba: Timuna, Aluva, Yeteti,
Oholibama, Ela, Pinoni,
Kenazi, Temani, Mibuzari,
Magidiyeli na Iramu. Abo ni bo bari abakuru b’imiryango ya Edomu.

headings.text: Kuva kuri Adamu gushika kuri Nowa

verses.text: Aba ni bo bahungu ba Isirayeli: Reyubeni, Simeyoni, Lewi, Yuda, Isakari, Zebuloni,
Dani, Yosefu, Benyamini, Nafutali, Gadi na Asheri.
Bene Yuda ni aba: Eri, Onani na Shela. Abo uko ari batatu yari yabavyaye ku Munyakananikazi, umukobwa wa Shuwa. (Eri, imfura ya Yuda yari umunyakibi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho ; nuko Uhoraho aramwica.)
Yuda yavyaye Perezi na Zera ku mukazana wiwe Tamari. Yuda yari afise abahungu batanu bose hamwe.
Bene Perezi ni aba: Hezironi na Hamuli.
Bene Zera ni aba: Zimuri, Etani, Hemani, Kalikoli na Daruda: bose hamwe bari batanu.
Mwene Karumi yari: Akani, yateje amagorwa menshi Abisirayeli mu kunyuruza ibintu vyari vyagizwe inyegu y’ Uhoraho .
Mwene Etani yari: Azariya.
Bene Hezironi bari: Yerahimeyeli, Ramu na Kalebu.
Ramu ni we se wa Aminadabu, Aminadabu avyara Nahashoni, yari umukuru w’umuryango wa Yuda.
Nahashoni yari se wa Salumoni, Salumoni yavyaye Bowazi,
Bowazi yavyaye Obedi maze Obedi avyara Isayi.
Isayi yari se wa Eliyabu imfura yiwe; umuhungu wiwe wa kabiri yari Abinadabu, uwa gatatu yari Shimeya,
Uwa kane Netaneli, uwa gatanu Radayi,
uwa gatandatu Ozemi n’uw’indwi Dawidi.
Bashiki babo bari Zeruwiya na Abigayili. Bene Zeruwiya batatu bari Abishayi, Yowabu na Asaheli.
Abigayili yari nyina wa Amasa, se wa Amasa yari Yeteri Umwishimayeli.
Kalebu mwene Hezironi yari afise abana yavyaranye n’umugore wiwe Azuba Yeriyoti. Aba ni bo bari abahungu biwe: Yesheri, Shobabu na Arudoni.
Azuba apfuye, Kalebu yarongoye Efurata, amuvyarako Huri.
Huri ni we yari se wa Uri, Uri na we yari se wa Bezaleli.
Mu nyuma, Hezironi amaze imyaka mirongo itandatu arongora umukobwa wa Makiri se wa Gileyadi. Aryamana na we, aca avyara Segubi.
Segubi yavyaye Yayiro, yatwara ibisagara mirongo ibiri na bitatu i Gileyadi.
Ariko Geshuri na Siriya bigarurira Havivoti Yayiro, Kenati hamwe n’ibigwati bihakikuje, vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara mirongo itandatu. Abo bose bari abakomoka kuri Makiri se wa Gileyadi.
Hezironi amaze gupfira mu gisagara ca Kalebu Efurata, Abiya umugore wa Hezironi amuvyarira umuhungu amwita Ashihuri ari we se wa Tekowa.
Aba ni bene Yerahimeyeli imfura ya Hezironi: Rami imfura yiwe, Buna, Oreni, Ozemi na Ahiya.
Yerahimeyeli yari afise uwundi mugore, yitwa Atara; Ni we nyina wa Onamu.
Aba ni bo bene Rami imfura ya Yerahimeyeli: Mayazi, Yamini na Ekeri.
Bene Onamu ni: Shamayi na Yada. Bene Shamayi ni: Nadabu na Abishuri.
Umugore wa Abishuri yitwa Abihayili, ari we yamuvyariye Ahibani na Molidi.
Bene Nadabu ni: Seledi na Apipayimu. Seledi yapfuye atavyaye.
Mwene Apipayimu ni: Ishi, ari we se wa Sheshani. Sheshani yari se wa Ahilayi.
Bene Yada, umuvukanyi wa Shamayi ni: Yeteri na Yonatani. Yeteri yapfuye atavyaye.
Bene Yonatani ni: Peleti na Zaza. Abo ni bo ruvyaro rwa Yerahimeyeli.
Sheshani nta bahungu yari afise, yavyaye abakobwa gusa. Yari afise umugurano w’Umunyegiputa yitwa Yarahu.
Sheshani ashingira umukobwa wiwe uwo mugurano wiwe Yarahu, aca avyara Atayi.
Atayi ni we se wa Natani, Natani akaba se wa Zabadi,
Zabadi akaba se wa Efulali, Efulali akaba se wa Obedi,
Obedi se wa Yehu, Yehu se wa Azariya,
Azariya mwene Helezi, Helezi se wa Eleyasa
Eleyasa se wa Sisimayi, Sisimayi se wa Shalumu,
Shalumu se wa Yekamiya, Yekamiya se wa Elishama.
Bene Kalebu umuvukanyi wa Yerahimeyeli ni: Mesha imfura yiwe, ari we yari se wa Zifu, n’umuhungu wiwe Maresha, yari se wa Heburoni.
Bene Heburoni ni: Kora, Tapuwa, Rekemu na Shema.
Shema ni we yari se wa Rahamu, Rahamu akaba se wa Yorikeyamu. Rekemu yari se wa Shamayi.
Mwene Shamayi yari Mayoni, Mayoni akaba se wa Beti-Zuri.
Efa, incoreke ya Kalebu ni we yari nyina wa Harani, Moza na Gazezi. Harani yari se w’uwundi Gazezi.
Bene Yahidayi ni: Regemu, Yotamu, Geshani, Peleti, Efa na Shayafi.
Mayaka, incoreke ya Kalebu, ni we yari nyina wa Sheberi na Tirihana.
Ni we yavyaye kandi Shayafi se wa Madumana na Sheva se wa Makibena na Gibeya. Umukobwa wa Kalebu yari Akisa.
Abo ni bo bakomoka kuri Kalebu. Abakomoka kuri Huri imfura ya Efurata ni: Shobali se wa Kiriyati-Yeyarimu,
Saluma se wa Betelehemu, na Harefu se wa Beti-Gaderi.
Abakomoka kuri Shobali se wa Kiriyati-Yeyarimu ni: Harowe, igice c’Abamenuhoti,
kandi imiryango ya Kiriyati-Yeyarimu yari: Abaturi, Abaputi, Abashumati n’Abamishirayi. Abo ni bo bandurukwako n’Abazorati n’Abeshitayoli.
Abakomoka kuri Saluma ni: Betelehemu, Abanetofati, Aturoti-Beti-Yowabu, igice c’Abamanahati, Abazori,
n’imiryango y’abanyabwenge b’ivyanditswe baba i Yabesi: Abatirati, Abashimeyati n’Abasukati. Abo ni Abakayini bakomoka kuri Hamati, se w’ab’inzu ya Rekabu.
Aba ni bo bahungu Dawidi yavyariye i Heburoni: imfura yiwe ni Amunoni, nyina yari Ahinowamu w’i Yezireyeli; uwa kabiri ni Daniyeli, nyina yari Abigayili w’i Karumeli;
uwa gatatu ni Abusalomu, nyina yari Mayaka umukobwa wa Talumayi umwami w’i Geshuri; uwa kane ni Adoniya, nyina yari Hagiti;
uwa gatanu, Shefatiya, nyina yari Abitali; n’uwa gatandatu, Itureyamu, uwo yavyaranye n’umugore wiwe Egula.
Abo uko ari batandatu ni bo Dawidi yavyariye i Heburoni, aho yamaze imyaka indwi n’amezi atandatu ari umwami. Imyaka Dawidi yamaze ari umwami i Yerusalemu ni mirongo itatu n’itatu,
kandi aba ni bo bana yavyariye i Yerusalemu: Shimeya, Shobabu, Natani na Salomo. Abo uko ari bane yabavyaranye na Batisheba umukobwa wa Amiyeli.
Hariho na Ibuhari, Elishama, Elifeleti,
Nogahu, Nefegi, Yafiya,
Elishama, Eliyada na Elifeleti, bose hamwe bari icenda.
Abo bose ni bo bari bene Dawidi, udashizemwo abo yavyaranye n’incoreke ziwe. Kandi Tamari ni we wenyene yari mushiki wabo.
Abakomoka kuri Salomo ni Rehobowamu umuhungu wiwe, Abiya umuhungu wiwe, Asa umuhungu wiwe, Yehoshafati
umuhungu wiwe, Yoramu umuhungu wiwe, Ahaziya umuhungu wiwe, Yowashi
umuhungu wiwe, Amaziya umuhungu wiwe, Azariya umuhungu wiwe, Yotamu
umuhungu wiwe, Ahazi umuhungu wiwe, Hezekiya umuhungu wiwe, Manase
umuhungu wiwe, Amoni umuhungu wiwe na Yosiya umuhungu wiwe.
Abagiye ku ngoma inyuma ya Yosiya ni aba: imfura yiwe Yohanani, umuhungu wiwe wa kabiri Yehoyakimu, umuhungu wiwe wa gatatu Zedekiya, umuhungu wiwe wa kane Shalumu ari we Yehowahazi,
Abagiye ku ngoma inyuma ya Yehoyakimu ni aba: umuhungu wiwe Yehoyakini ari we Yekoniya hamwe n’umuhungu wiwe Zedekiya.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Yehoyakini yajanywe ari inyagano ni: umuhungu wiwe Sheyalutiyeli,
Malukiramu, Pedaya, Shenazari, Yekamiya, Hoshama na Nedabiya.
Bene Pedaya ni: Zerubabeli na Shimeyi. Bene Zerubabeli ni: Meshulamu na Hananiya. Shelomiti yari mushiki wabo.
Hariho n’abandi batanu ari bo: Hashuba, Oheli, Berekiya, Hasadiya na Yushabu-Hesedi.
Abakomoka kuri Hananiya ni: Pelatiya na Yeshaya, n’abahungu ba Refaya, ba Arunani, ba Obadiya n’aba Shekaniya.
Abakomoka kuri Shekaniya ni: Shemaya n’abahungu biwe: Hatushi, Igali, Bariya, Neyariya na Shafati, bose bari batandatu.
Bene Neyariya ni: Eliyowenayi, Hezekiya na Azirikamu, bose bari batatu.
Bene Eliyowenayi ni: Hadoviya, Eliyashibu, Pelaya, Akubu, Yohanani, Delaya na Anani bose, bari indwi.

headings.text: Abo mu nda y’ingoma inyuma yo kuba inyagano

verses.text: Abakomoka kuri Yuda ni: Perezi, Hezironi, Karumi, Huri na Shobali.
Reyaya mwene Shobali yari se wa Yahati, Yahati akaba se wa Ahumayi na Lahadi. Abo bari abakuru b’inzu zigize Abazorati.
Aba ni bo bene Etamu: Yezireyeli, Ishima na Idibashi. Mushiki wabo yitwa Hazeleliponi.
Penuweli yari se wa Gedori, na Ezeri yari se wa Hushahi. Aba bari abakomoka kuri Huri, imfura ya Efurata akaba se wa Betelehemu.
Ashihuri se wa Tekowa yari afise abagore babiri, Hela na Nayara.
Nayara yamuvyariye Ahuzami, Heferi, Temeni na Hayahashitari. Abo ni bo bakomotse kuri Nayara.
Bene Hela ni: Zereti, Zohari, Etinani,
na Kozi, yari se wa Anubi na Hazobeba hamwe n’abakuru b’inzu zigize Ahariheli mwene Harumi.
Yabesi yarusha abavukanyi biwe icubahiro. Nyina wiwe yamwise Yabesi, agomba kuvuga ati: “Namuvyaye mu mubabaro mwinshi.”
Yabesi atakambira Imana y’Abisirayeli ati: “Icompa ukampezagira ukanyagurira intara yanje! Ukuboko kwawe kukabana nanje, ukandinda ikibi cose kugira ngo ntikimbabaze.” Maze Imana imuha ivyo yasavye.
Kelubi, umuvukanyi wa Shuha, yari se wa Mehiri, se wa Eshitoni.
Eshitoni yari se wa Beti-Rafa, Paseya na Tehina, se wa Iri-Nahashi. Abo bari abantu b’i Reka.
Bene Kenazi ni: Otiniyeli na Seraya. Bene Otiniyeli ni: Hatati na Mewonotayi.
Mewonotayi yari se wa Ofura. Seraya yari se wa Yowabu, se wa Ge-Harashimu. Bahise gutyo kubera yuko abantu baho bari abahinga mu bikorwa.
Bene Kalebu mwene Yefune ni: Iru, Ela na Nayamu. Mwene Ela ni: Kenazi.
Bene Yehaleleli ni: Zifu, Zifa, Tiriya na Asareli.
Bene Ezira ni: Yeteri, Meredi, Eferi na Yaloni. Umwe mu bagore ba Meredi ni we yavyaye Miriyamu, Shamayi na Ishiba se wa Eshitemowa.
Abo bari abana b’umukobwa wa Farawo Bitiya, uwo Meredi yari yararongoye. Umugore wiwe akomoka mu muryango wa Yuda ni we yavyaye Yeredi se wa Gedori, Heberi se wa Soko, na Yekutiyeli se wa Zanowa.
Abahungu bavutse ku mugore wa Hodiya, mushiki wa Nahamu ni: Se wa Keyila Umugarumi, na Eshitemowa Umumayaka.
Bene Shimoni ni: Amunoni, Rina, Beni-Hanani na Tiloni. Abakomoka kuri Ishi: Zoheti na Beni-Zoheti.
Abakomoka kuri Shela mwene Yuda ni: Eri se wa Leka, Layada se wa Maresha n’imiryango y’abakora impuzu zera derere b’i Beti-Ashibeya,
Yokimu, abantu b’i Kozeba, na Yowashi na Sarafu, baganza i Mowabu na Yabushi Lehemu. Ibi vyanditswe ni ivyo mu bihe vya kera.
Ni bo babumvyi b’inkono baba i Netayimu n’i Gedera; bagumyeho kandi bakorera umwami.
Abakomoka kuri Simeyoni ni: Nemuweli, Yamini, Yaribu, Zera, na Shawuli;
Shawuli yavyaye Shalumu, Shalumu avyara Mibusamu, Mibusamu nawe avyara Mishima.
Abakomoka kuri Mishima ni: Shimeyi mwene Zakuri, Zakuri mwene Hamuweli.
Shimeyi yari afise abahungu icumi na batandatu n’abakobwa batandatu, ariko abo bavukana ntibaronse abana benshi; ni co catumye umuryango wabo wose utabaye munini nk’umuryango wa Yuda.
Baba i Berisheba, i Molada, i Hazari-Shuwali,
i Biluha, i Ezemu, i Toladi,
i Betuweli, i Horuma, i Zikulagi,
i Beti-Marukaboti, i Hazari-Susimu, i Beti-Biri n’i Shayarayimu. Ivyo ni vyo vyari ibisagara vyabo gushika ku ngoma ya Dawidi.
Ibigwati vyabo vyari bihakikije vyari Etamu, Ayini, Rimoni, Tokeni na Ashani, vyose hamwe vyari ibisagara bitanu,
n’ibindi bigwati vyose vyari bihakikije gushika i Bayali. Aho ni ho baba. Uru ni rwo rutonde rwa ba sekuruza babo:
Mu bandi bakomotse kuri Simeyoni harimwo Meshobabu, Yamileki, Yosha mwene Amaziya,
Yoweli; Yehu mwene Yoshibiya, mwene Seraya, mwene Asiyeli,
na Eliyowenayi, Yakoba, Yeshohaya, Asaya, Adiyeli, Yesimiyeli, Benaya,
na Ziza mwene Shifi, mwene Aloni, mwene Yedaya, mwene Shimuri, mwene Shemaya.
Urwo ni rwo rutonde rw’amazina y’abakuru b’inzu zabo. Uruvyaro rwabo rwaragwira cane,
maze baragenda gushika kw’irembo ry’i Gedori mu buseruko bw’ikiyaya barondera uburagiro bw’amasho yabo.
Basanga hari ubwatsi bwiza, butotahaye, kandi hagutse, hari amahoro, hatekanye. Abahamu ni bo bahora bahaba ubwa mbere.

Igihe Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda yari ku ngoma, abo bakuru bavuzwe bo mu muryango wa Simeyoni, batera iyo ntara y’Abahamu baba ngaho barabamara bose co kimwe n’Abameyunimu, nk’uko biri kugeza n’ubu. Maze baca basubira mu bibanza vyabo, kuko hari uburagiro bw’amasho yabo.
Kandi abashika amajana atanu b’Abasimeyoni, barongowe na Pelatiya, Neyariya, Refaya na Uziyeli, bene Ishi, batera mu misozi y’i Seyiri.
Bica Abamaleki bari basigaye bahahungiye, baca bibera ngaho gushika n’uwu musi.

headings.text: Abandi bakuru b’inzu mu muryango wa Yuda

verses.text: Umuhungu w’imfura wa Isirayeli yari Reyubeni. Ariko kubera yahumanije uburiri bwa se mu kuryamana n’umwe mu bagore biwe, vyatumye ukuba samuragwa kwiwe guhabwa bene Yosefu mwene Isirayeli. Ico ni co catumye atandikwa mu rukurikirane rw’intonde z’imfura.
Kandi naho Yuda ari we yarusha inkomezi bene se, kandi uwuganza akaba yavuye mu muryango wiwe, uburenganzira bwo kuba samuragwa bwahawe Yosefu.
Bene Reyubeni, imfura ya Isirayeli, ni: Hanoki, Palu, Hezironi na Karumi.
Abakomoka kuri Yoweli ni: Shemaya, Gogi, Shimeyi,
Mika, Reyaya, Bayali,
Beyera, uwo Tigulati-Pilineseri umwami w’i Ashuri yajanye nk’inyagano. Beyera yari umukuru w’umuryango w’Abareyubeni.
Abakuru b’inzu mu muryango wabo, banditswe hakurikijwe uru rukurikirane: Yeyiyeli umukuru wabo, Zakariya,
hamwe na Bela mwene Azazi, mwene Shema, umuhungu wa Yoweli. Baba mu ntara iva ahitwa Aroweri igashika i Nebo n’i Bayali-Meyoni.
Mu buseruko, baba mu gice gishika hafi y’ubugaragwa bugarukira ku ruzi Efurate, kuko imikuku yabo yari yaragwiririye i Gileyadi.
Ku ngoma y’umwami Sawuli bagwanije Abahaguri, barabanesha; baca bigarurira aho Abahaguri bahora baba ari yo ntara yose iri mu buseruko bw’i Gileyadi.
Abagadi bahana urubibe n’Abareyubeni ahitwa Bashani, gushika i Saleka:
Yoweli ni we yari umukuru wabo, Shafamu akaba icegera ciwe, hagakurikira Yanayi na Shafati b’i Bashani.
Abo mu miryango yabo, nk’uko amazu yabo yari ari, bari: Mikayeli, Meshulamu, Sheba, Yorayi, Yakani, Ziya na Eberi, bose bari indwi.
Aba ni bo bari bene Abihayili mwene Huri, mwene Yarowa, mwene Gileyadi, mwene Mikayeli, mwene Yeshishayi, mwene Yahido, mwene Buzi.
Ahi mwene Abudiyeli, mwene Guni, ni we yari umukuru w’umuryango wabo.
Abagadi baba i Gileyadi, i Bashani n’ibigwati vyahegukira, hamwe n’uburagiro bwose bw’i Sharoni iyo bwashika hose.
Abo bose banditswe mu bitabu vy’intonde ku ngoma ya Yotamu umwami w’i Buyuda na Yerobowamu umwami w’Ubwisirayeli.

Abareyubeni, Abagadi n’igice c’umuryango wa Manase bari bafise ingabo zingana ibihumbi mirongo ine na bine n’amajana indwi na mirongo itandatu biteguye kuja ku rugamba, bize ivyo kugwana bashobora gukoresha inkinzo n’inkota, bashobora no gukoresha umuheto, bigishijwe ivy’intambara.
Baja gutera Abahaguri b’i Yeturi, Nafishi n’i Nodabu.
Muri iyo ntambara bizigira Imana barayambaza ngo ibafashe, maze yumva ugusenga kwabo, itanga Abahaguri n’ababafasha mu maboko yabo.
Banyaga imikuku y’Abahaguri: ingamiya ibihumbi mirongo itanu, intama ibihumbi amajana abiri na mirongo itanu n’indogoba ibihumbi bibiri; bongera bajana abantu ibihumbi ijana nk’inyagano.
Abansi benshi bagwa mu ntambara, kuko Imana ari yo yariko irabagwanya. Baca bibera muri ico gihugu gushika mu gihe bajanwa nk’inyagano.
Abakomoka ku gice c’umuryango wa Manase bari benshi; baba mu ntara y’i Bashani gushika i Bayali-Herumoni, ari ho Seniri.

Aba ni bo bari abakuru b’inzu zigize uwo muryango: Eferi, Ishi, Eliyeli, Aziriyeli, Yeremiya, Hodaviya na Yahudiyeli. Bari abahizi bazi kugwana, ba rurangiranwa, bakaba abakuru b’inzu zigize uwo muryango wabo.
Ariko ntibubaha Imana ya ba sekuruza baca bifatanya n’ibigirwamana vy’abantu b’ico gihugu, abo Imana yirukanye imbere yabo.

Maze Imana ya Isirayeli ikangura umutima wa Puli umwami w’i Ashuri: uwo ni we Tigulati-Pilineseri umwami w’i Ashuri, aca atwara nk’inyagano Abareyubeni, Abagadi n’igice c’umuryango wa Manase. Abajana i Halahi, Habori, Hara no ku ruzi rw’i Gozani, aho bagumye kugeza n’ubu.
Bene Lewi ni: Gerishoni, Kohati na Merari.
Bene Kohati ni: Amuramu, Izihari, Heburoni na Uziyeli.
Bene Amuramu ni: Aroni, Mose na Miriyamu. Bene Aroni ni: Nadabu, Abihu, Eliyazeri na Itamari.
Eliyazeri yavyaye Finehasi, Finehasi avyara Abishuwa,
Abishuwa avyara Buki, Buki avyara Uzi,
Uzi avyara Zerahiya, Zerahiya avyara Merayoti,
Merayoti avyara Amariya, Amariya avyara Ahitubu,
Ahitubu avyara Sadoki, Sadoki avyara Ahimazi,
Ahimazi avyara Azariya, Azariya avyara Yohanani,
Yohanani avyara Azariya; ni we yabaye umuherezi mu Ngoro yubatswe na Salomo i Yerusalemu,
Azariya avyara Amariya, Amariya avyara Ahitubu,
Ahitubu avyara Sadoki, Sadoki avyara Shalumu,
Shalumu avyara Hilukiya, Hilikiya avyara Azariya,
Azariya avyara Seraya, Seraya avyara Yehozadaki.
Yehozadaki yajanywe nk’inyagano igihe Uhoraho yarekura Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu ngo bajanwe nk’inyagano na Nebukadineza.
Bene Lewi ni: Gerishoni, Kohati na Merari.
Aya ni yo mazina ya bene Gerishoni: Libuni na Shimeyi.
Bene Kohati ni: Amuramu, Izihari, Heburoni na Uziyeli.
Bene Merari ni: Mahuli na Mushi. Aba ni bo bakuru b’inzu zigize umuryango w’Abalewi, banditswe nk’uko amazu ya ba se ari.
Uru ni rwo ruvyaro rwa Gerishomu: Gerishomu yavyaye Libuni, Libuni avyara Yahati, Yahati avyara Zima,
Zima avyara Yowa, Yowa avyara Ido, Ido avyara Zera, Zera avyara Yeyaterayi.
Uru ni rwo ruvyaro rwa Kohati: Kohati yavyaye Aminadabu, Aminadabu avyara Kora, Kora avyara Asiri,
Asiri avyara Elukana, Elukana avyara Ebiyasafu, Ebiyasafu avyara Asiri,
Asiri avyara Tahati, Tahati avyara Uriyeli, Uriyeli avyara Uziya, Uziya avyara Shawuli.
Abakomoka kuri Elukana ni: Amasayi, Ahimoti.
Ahimoti yavyaye Elukana, Elukana avyara Zofayi, Zofayi avyara Nahati,
Nahati avyara Eliyabu, Eliyabu avyara Yerohamu, Yerohamu avyara Elukana, Elukana avyara Samweli.
Bene Samweli ni: Yoweli imfura yiwe na Abiya umuhungu wiwe wa kabiri.
Uru ni rwo ruvyaro rwa Merari: Merari yavyaye Mahuli, Mahuli avyara Libuni, Libuni avyara Shimeyi, Shimeyi avyara Uza,
Uza avyara Shimeya, Shimeya avyara Hagiya, Hagiya avyara Asaya.
Aba ni bo Dawidi yashizeho ngo bazezwe gucuraranga mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho isandugu imaze kuhashika.
Bakorera Imana mu gucurarangira imbere y’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, gushika Salomo yubatse Ingoro y’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu. Bakora igikorwa cabo bakurikije amategeko bahawe.
Aba ni bo bantu bokora ico gikorwa, hamwe n’abahungu babo: Abakomoka kuri Kohati ni: Hemani, umucuraranzi, mwene Yoweli, Yoweli mwene Samweli,
Samweli mwene Elukana, Elukana mwene Yerohamu, Yerohamu mwene Eliyeli, Eliyeli mwene Towa,
Towa mwene Zufi, Zufi mwene Elukana, Elukana mwene Mahati, Mahati mwene Amasayi,
Amasayi mwene Elukana, Elukana mwene Yoweli, Yoweli mwene Azariya, Azariya mwene Zefaniya,
Zefaniya mwene Tahati, Tahati mwene Asiri, Asiri mwene Ebiyasafu, Ebiyasafu mwene Kora,
Kora mwene Izihari, Izihari mwene Kohati, Kohati mwene Lewi, Lewi mwene Isirayeli;
kandi Asafu ni we yari umukuru w’umugwi wakorera i buryo bwa Hemani. Asafu yari mwene Berekiya, Berekiya mwene Shimeya,
Shimeya mwene Mikayeli, Mikayeli mwene Bayaseyiya, Bayaseya mwene Malikiya,
Malikiya mwene Etini, Etini mwene Zera, Zera mwene Adaya,
Adaya mwene Etani, Etani mwene Zima, Zima mwene Shimeyi,
Shimeyi mwene Yahati, Yahati mwene Gerishoni, Gerishomu mwene Lewi.
Abandi bari bafatanije na we bari i bubamfu bwiwe ni abakomoka kuri Merari: Etani yari mwene Kishi, Kishi mwene Abudi, Abudi mwene Maluki,
Maluki mwene Hashabiya, Hashabiya mwene Amaziya, Amaziya mwene Hilukiya,
Hilukiya mwene Amuzi, Amuzi mwene Bani, Bani mwene Shemeri,
Shemeri mwene Mahuli, Mahuli mwene Mushi, Mushi mwene Merari, Merari mwene Lewi.
Abandi Balewi bagenzi babo bari bashinzwe ibindi bikorwa vyo mw’ihema, inzu y’Imana.

Ariko Aroni n’abo mu ruvyaro rwiwe ni bo bari bashinzwe gutanga ibimazi ku gicaniro co guturirirako ibimazi n’ico guturirirako ibimota neza hamwe n’ibikorwa vyose bijanye n’ivyakorerwa Ahera Cane, harimwo gutanga impongano z’Abisirayeli, nk’uko Mose umusavyi w’Imana yari yarabitegetse.
Aba ni bo bakomoka kuri Aroni: Aroni yavyaye Eliyazeri, Eliyazeri avyara Finehasi, Finehasi avyara Abishuwa,
Abishuwa avyara Buki, Buki avyara Uzi, Uzi avyara Zerahiya,
Zerahiya avyara Merayoti, Merayoti avyara Amariya, Amariya avyara Ahitubu,
Ahitubu avyara Sadoki, Sadoki avyara Ahimazi.
Ibi ni vyo bisagara bahawe ngo babemwo nk’uko vyari vyaragenywe, vyari vyahawe abo mu nzu ya Kohati bo mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni, kuko umugabane wa mbere wari uwabo:
Bahawe Heburoni mu Buyuda n’uburagiro buhakikuje.
Ariko imirima n’ibigwati bikikuje ico gisagara vyahawe Kalebu mwene Yefune.
Nuko abakomoka kuri Aroni bahawe ibisagara vy’ubuhungiro ari vyo Heburoni, Libuna, Yatiri, Eshitemowa,
Hileni, Debiri,
Ashani, Yuta n’i Beti-Shemeshi, hamwe rero n’uburagiro bwaho.
Mu muryango wa Benyamini bahawe i Gibeyoni, Geba, Alemeti n’i Anatoti, hamwe n’uburagiro bwaho. Ibisagara, vyahawe Abakohati, vyari icumi na bitatu vyose hamwe.
Abasigaye mu Bakohati bahawe umugabane w’ibisagara cumi mu gice kimwe c’umuryango wa Manase.
Abakomoka kuri Gerishomu, umuryango ku muryango, bahawe ibisagara icumi na bitatu vyo mu miryango ya Isakari, Asheri na Nafutali, no mu gice kimwe c’umuryango wa Manase cari i Bashani.
Abakomotse kuri Merari, umuryango ku muryango, bahawe umugabane w’ibisagara icumi na bibiri vyo mu miryango ya Reyubeni, Gadi na Zebuloni.
Nuko Abisirayeli baha Abalewi ivyo bisagara n’uburagiro bwavyo.
Mu miryango ya Yuda, Simeyoni na Benyamini, baronse umugabane w’ivyo bisagara vyavuzwe, hakoreshejwe ubufindo.
Bamwe bo mu Bakohati bahawe ibisagara vyabo mu muryango wa Efurayimu.
Mu misozi y’Abefurayimu bahawe Shekemu nk’igisagara c’ubuhungiro, na Gezeri,
Yokimeyamu, Beti-Horoni,
Ayaloni n’i Gati-Rimoni, hamwe n’uburagiro bwaho.
Kandi mu gice kimwe c’Abamanase, Abisirayeli batanze Aneri na Bileyami, hamwe n’uburagiro bwaho, ku miryango yasigaye y’Abakohati.
Abagerishomu baronse aha hakurikira: Mu gice c’umuryango w’Abamanase baronse ibisagara Golani h’i Bashani n’i Ashitaroti, hamwe n’uburagiro bwaho;
Mu muryango wa Isakari baronse Kedeshi, Daberati,
Ramoti na Anemi, hamwe n’uburagiro bwaho;
Mu muryango wa Asheri baronse Mashali, Abudoni,
Hukoki n’i Rehobu, hamwe n’uburagiro bwaho.
No mu muryango wa Nafutali baronse Kedeshi i Galilaya, Hamoni na Kiriyatayimu, hamwe n’uburagiro bwaho.
Abandi bakomoka kuri Merari basigaye mu Balewi, baronse aha hakurikira: Mu muryango wa Zebuloni baronse Yokineyami, Karita, Rimoni na Tabori, hamwe n’uburagiro bwaho;
mu muryango wa Reyubeni hakurya ya Yorodani mu buseruko bwa Yeriko baronse Bezeri mu bugaragwa, Yahiza,
Kedemoti na Mefayati, hamwe n’uburagiro bwaho;
no mu muryango wa Gadi baronse Ramoti h’i Gileyadi, Mahanayimu,
Heshiboni na Yazeri, hamwe n’uburagiro bwaho.
Bene Isakari ni: Tola, Puwa, Yashubi na Shimuroni, bose bari bane.

Bene Tola ni: Uzi, Refaya, Yeriyeli, Yahimayi, Ibusami, na Samweli, abakuru b’inzu zabo. Ku ngoma ya Dawidi, abakomoka kuri Tola bari mu runganwe rw’abagwanyi b’abahizi bari ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri n’amajana atandatu.
Abakomoka kuri Uzi ni: Izirahiya. Abakomoka kuri Izirahiya ni: Mikayeli, Obadiya, Yoweli na Ishiya. Uko ari batanu bari abakuru b’amazu.
Ukurikije urutonde rw’ingene bagiye bararondoka, bari bafise abantu ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bitandatu biteguriye kuja ku rugamba, kubera bari bafise abagore n’abahungu benshi.
Abo mu nzu zigize umuryango wa Isakari bari mu runganwe rw’abagwanyi b’abahizi, bose hamwe bari ibihumbi mirongo umunani n’indwi.
Bene Benyamini batatu ni: Bela, Bekeri na Yediyayeli.

Bene Bela ni: Eziboni, Uzi, Uziyeli, Yerimoti na Iri, abakuru b’imiryango: bose bari batanu. Urutonde rw’abari mu runganwe rwo gushobora kuja mu rugamba bari ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri na mirongo itatu na bane.
Bene Bekeri ni: Zemira, Yowashi, Eliyezeri, Eliyowenayi, Omuri, Yeremoti, Abiya, Anatoti na Alemeti. Abo bose bari bene Bekeri.
Urutonde rwabo, hakurikijwe ingene urunganwe rwagenda rurakurikirana n’urundi, rwerekana abakuru b’amazu agize uwo muryango, abagwanyi b’inkomezi, ibihumbi mirongo ibiri n’amajana abiri.
Mwene Yediyayeli ni: Biluhani. Bene Bilihani ni: Yewushi, Benyamini, Ehudi, Kenayana, Zetani, Tarushishi na Ahishahari.
Abahungu bose bene Yediyayeli bari abakuru b’amazu agize uwo muryango wabo. Hari ibihumbi cumi n’indwi n’amajana abiri vy’ingabo biteguriye kuja ku rugamba.
Shupimu na Hupimu bakomoka kuri Iri, Hushimu na we agakomoka kuri Aheri.
Bene Nafutali ni: Yahuziyeli, Guni, Yezeri na Shalumu, bakomoka kuri Biluha.
Abakomotse kuri Manase ni: Asiriyeli akomoka kuri we yamuvyaranye n’incoreke yiwe y’Umwaramukazi. Ni we yavyaye Makiri se wa Gileyadi.
Makiri aronderera umugore Hupimu na Shupimu. Mushikiwe yitwa Mayaka. Uwundi akomoka kuri we ni Zelofehadi, yavyaye abakobwa gusa.
Mayaka Muka Makiri yavyaye umuhungu amwita Pereshi. Umuvukanyi wiwe yitwa Shereshi, kandi abahungu biwe bari Ulamu na Rakemu.
Mwene Ulamu ni: Bedani. Abo ni bo bari bene Gileyadi mwene Makiri, mwene Manase.
Mushikiwe Hamoleketi yavyaye Ishihodi, Abiyezeri na Mahila.
Bene Shemida bari: Ahiyani, Shekemu, Likihi na Aniyamu.
abakomoka kuri Efurayimu ni: Shutela, umuhungu wiwe Beredi umuhungu wiwe Tahati, umuhungu wiwe Eleyada, umuhungu wiwe Tahati,
umuhungu wiwe Zabadi, n’umuhungu wiwe Shutela. Ezeri na Eladi bishwe n’imvukira z’i Gati, igihe bamanuka ngo bazinyage imikuku yazo.
Sewabo Efurayimu yabagandariye imisi myinshi, maze incuti ziwe ziraza ziramuremesha.
Maze yongera kuryamana n’umugore wiwe, aca asama inda, avyara umwana w’umuhungu. Se aca amwita Beriya, kuko mu nzu yiwe hari harateye ivyago.
Umukobwa wiwe yari Shera, ari we yubatse Beti-Horoni y’epfo n’iya ruguru hamwe na Uzeni-Shera.
Ni we yavyara Refa, na we akavyara Reshefu, na we akavyara Tela, na we akavyara Tahani,
na we akavyara Ladani, na we akavyara Amihudi, na we akavyara Elishama,
na we akavyara Nuni, ari we se wa Yosuwa.

Amatongo yabo n’ibisagara vyabo vyarimwo Beteli n’ibigwati bihakikije, Nayarani mu buseruko, Gezeri n’ibigwati vyaho mu burengero, na Shekemu n’ibigwati vyaho kubandanya gushika i Ayiya n’ibigwati vyaho.
Abakomoka kuri Manase bagarukira i Beti-Shani, Tanaki, Megido na Dori, hamwe n’ibisagara vyaho. Abakomoka kuri Yosefu mwene Isirayeli baba muri ivyo bisagara.
Bene Asheri ni: Imuna, Ishuva, Ishuvi na Beriya. Mushiki wabo yari Sera.
Bene Beriya ni: Heberi na Malukiyeli, yari se wa Biruzayiti.
Heberi yari se wa Yafuleti, Shomeri na Hotamu na mushiki wabo Shuwa.
Bene Yafuleti ni: Pasaki, Bimuhali na Ashuvati. Abo ni bo bari bene Yafuleti.
Bene Shemeri ni: Ahi, Rohiga, Huba na Aramu.
Abahungu b’umuvukanyi wiwe Helemu ni: Zofa, Imuna, Sheleshi na Amali.
Bene Zofa ni: Suwa, Haruneferi, Shuwali, Beri, Imura,
Bezeri, Hodi, Shama, Shilusha, Itirani na Bera.
Bene Yeteri ni: Yefune, Pisipa na Ara.
Bene Ula ni: Ara, Haniyeli na Riziya.

Abo bose bakomoka kuri Asheri, bari abakuru b’inzu, abantu b’indobanurwa, abagwanyi b’abahizi kandi bakaba n’abarongozi b’intwari. Igitigiri c’abari mu runganwe rwo gushobora kuja mu rugamba, nk’uko vyari ku rutonde rw’ingene abantu bagiye bararondoka, bari ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitandatu.
Benyamini yari afise imfura yitwa Bela, umuhungu wiwe wa kabiri akitwa Ashibeli, uwa gatatu na we akitwa Ahara,
uwa kane ni Noha, uwa gatanu ni Rafa.
Bene Bela bari: Adari, Gera, Abihudi,
Abishuwa, Namani, Ahowa,
Gera, Shefufani na Huramu.
Aba ni bo bakomoka kuri Ehudi, bari abakuru b’amazu y’ababa i Geba bajanywe ari inyagano i Manahati:
Abahungu ba Ehudi bari Namani, Ahiya, na Gera. Uwo Gera ni we yabajane ari inyagano, kandi ni we yari se wa Uza na Ahihudi.
Hari abahungu Shaharayimu yavyariye i Mowabu amaze kwirukana abagore biwe Hushimi na Bayara.
Ku mugore wiwe Hodeshi yavyaye Yobabu, Zibiya, Mesha, Malukamu,
Yewuzi, Sakiya na Miruma. Abo bari abahungu biwe, bakaba abakuru b’amazu.
Kuri Hushimi yavyaye Abitubi na Elupayali.
Bene Elupayali ni: Eberi, Mishamu, Shemedi (ari we yubatse i Ono n’i Lodi n’ibigwati bihakikije),
na Beriya na Shema, bari abakuru b’amazu y’ababa i Ayaloni basohoye ababa i Gati.
Ahiyo, Shashaki, Yeremoti,
Zebadiya, Aradi, Ederi,
Mikayeli, Ishipa na Yoha bari bene Beriya.
Zebadiya, Meshulamu, Hizuki, Heberi,
Ishimerayi, Iziliya na Yobabu bari bene Elupayali.
Yakimu, Zikuri, Zabudi,
Eliyenayi, Ziletayi, Eliyeli,
Adaya, Beraya na Shimurati bari bene Shimeyi.
Ishupani, Eberi, Eliyeli,
Abudoni, Zikuri, Hanani,
Hananiya, Elamu, Antotiya,
Ifideya na Penuweli bari bene Shashaki.
Shamusherayi, Shehariya, Ataliya,
Yayareshiya, Eliya, na Zikuri bari bene Yerohamu.
Abo bose bari abakuru b’amazu, baganza nk’uko vyanditswe mu rutonde rwerekana ingene abantu bagenda bararondoka, kandi baba i Yerusalemu.
Se wa Gibeyoni yaba i Gibeyoni. Umugore wiwe yitwa Mayaka,
kandi imfura yiwe yari Abudoni, agakurikirwa na Zuri, Kishi, Bayali, Neri, Nadabu,
Gedori, Ahiyo, Zekeri
na Mikuloti, yari se wa Shimeya. Na bo nyene babana n’abo mu miryango y’iwabo i Yerusalemu.
Neri yari se wa Kishi, Kishi se wa Sawuli, Sawuli se wa Yonatani, Maluki-Shuwa, Abinadabu na Eshibayali.
Mwene Yonatani, ni Meribu-Bayali, na we akaba yavyaye Mika.
Bene Mika, ni Pitoni, Meleki, Tareya na Ahazi.
Ahazi yari se wa Yehoyada, Yehoyada yari se wa Alemeti, Azimaveti na Zimuri, Zimuri na we akaba se wa Moza.
Moza yari se wa Bineya, Bineya ni se wa Rafa, Rafa se wa Eleyasa, Eleyasa se wa Azeli.
Azeli yari afise abahungu batandatu, kandi aya ni yo mazina yabo: Azurikamu, Bokeru, Ishimayeli, Sheyariya, Obadiya na Hanani. Abo bose bari bene Azeli.
Abahungu b’umuvukanyi wiwe Esheki bari: Ulamu imfura yiwe, Yewushi uwa kabiri, na Elifeleti uwa gatatu.
Bene Ulamu bari abahizi mu ntambara bashobora kurasisha umuheto. Bari bafise abahungu benshi, n’abuzukuru benshi bashika ijana na mirongo itanu bose. Abo bose bakomoka kuri Benyamini.
Abisirayeli bose bashizwe ku ntonde z’imiryango bakomokamwo mu gitabu c’abami b’Abisirayeli. Abayuda bajanywe nk’inyagano i Babiloni kubera batabaye abizigirwa ku Imana.
Maze abantu ba mbere mu bavuye mu kinyago batanguye gusubira mu bisagara vyabo no mu matongo yabo bari Abisirayeli bamwebamwe, abaherezi, Abalewi n’abakozi bo mu Ngoro.
Abakomoka kuri Yuda, kuri Benyamini, kuri Efurayimu no kuri Manase baba i Yerusalemu bari:
Utayi mwene Amihudi, umuhungu wa Omuri, umuhungu wa Imuri, umuhungu wa Bani, akomoka kuri Perezi mwene Yuda.
Mu Bashiloni abatashe ni: Asaya imfura n’abahungu biwe.
Mu bo mu nzu kwa Zera ni: Yeyuweli. Abakomoka kuri Yuda bari amajana atandatu na mirongo icenda.
Mu bakomoka kuri Benyamini ni: Salu mwene Meshulamu, mwene Hodaviya, mwene Hasenuwa;
Ibuneya mwene Yerohamu; Ela mwene Uzi, mwene Mikiri; na Meshulamu mwene Shefatiya, mwene Reyuweli, mwene Ibuniya.
Abantu bo mu Babenyamini, nk’uko bashizwe ku rutonde rwerekana ingene bagiye bararondoka, bashika amajana icenda na mirongo itanu na batandatu. Abo bose bari abakuru b’amazu yabo.
Mu baherezi abatashe ni: Yedayiya; Yehoyaribu, Yakini;
Azariya mwene Hilukiya, mwene Meshulamu, mwene Sadoki, mwene Merayoti, mwene Ahitubu, abakuru bari bashinzwe inzu y’Imana;
Adaya mwene Yerohamu, mwene Pashuri, mwene Malikiya, na Mayasayi mwene Adiyeli, mwene Yahizera, mwene Meshulamu, mwene Meshilemiti, mwene Imeri.
Abaherezi, bari abakuru b’amazu, bashika igihumbi n’amajana indwi na mirongo itandatu. Bari abagabo bashoboye, bashinzwe gukora igikorwa c’Imana mw’ihema.
Mu Balewi: Shemaya mwene Hashubi, mwene Azirikamu, mwene Hashabiya, Umumerari;
Bakibakari, Hereshi, Galali na Mataniya mwene Mika, mwene Zikuri, mwene Asafu;
Obadiya mwene Shemaya, mwene Galali, mwene Yedutuni; na Berekiya mwene Asa, mwene Elukana, yaba mu bigwati vy’Abanetofati.
Abarinzi b’amarembo bari: Shalumu, Akubu, Talumoni, Ahimani n’abo bavukana, Shalumu uwabatwara
yaba kw’Irembo ry’Umwami mu buseruko, gushika n’ubu. Abo ni bo bari abarinzi b’irembo bo mu Balewi.

Shalumu mwene Kore, mwene Ebiyasafu, mwene Kora, na bagenzibe b’abarinzi b’irembo bo mu muryango wiwe ari bo Bakorahi bari bajejwe kurinda umuryango w’ihema nk’uko ba se babikora kw’ihema ry’ Uhoraho .
Mu bihe vya kera Finehasi mwene Eliyazeri ni we yari umukuru w’abarinzi b’irembo, kandi Uhoraho yari kumwe na we.
Zakariya mwene Meshelemiya yari umurinzi w’umuryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.

Bose hamwe, abari batowe ngo babe abarinzi b’amarembo bari amajana abiri na cumi na babiri. Bari banditswe mu bitabu vy’urukurikirane rw’ingene bagiye bararondoka mu mihana yabo. Abo barinzi b’amarembo bari bahawe ico gikorwa na Dawidi hamwe na Samweli uwerekwa kuko bari abantu bo kwizigirwa.
Abo hamwe n’uruvyaro rwabo bari bashinzwe kurinda amarembo y’inzu y’ Uhoraho , ari ryo hema.
Abarinzi b’irembo bari mu bibanza bine: mu buseruko, mu burengero, mu buraruko, no mu bumanuko.
Benewabo b’Abalewi bo mu bigwati vyabo baraza bakabasanga muri ivyo bikorwa mu kiringo c’imisi indwi.
Ariko abarinzi b’irembo bakurubakuru bane, bose bo mu Balewi, bari bizigiwe bazezwa igikorwa co kurinda ivyumba n’ubutunzi vyo mu Ngoro y’Imana.
Barashobora kumara ijoro ryose bacungereye iyo nzu y’Imana, kuko bategerezwa kuyirinda; kandi akaba ari bo bari bajejwe urupfunguruzo rwayo kugira ngo bame bayugurura uko bukeye.
Bamwe muri bo bari bajejwe ibikoresho vyo mw’ihema; bakama babiharura iyo vyinjiye canke iyo bisohotse.
Abandi bari bashinzwe gutunganya ibikoresho n’ivyera vyose vy’ahera, n’ifu n’umuvinyu, hamwe n’amavuta, ibiturirwa bikamota n’ibirungo.
Ariko abaherezi bamwe bari bajejwe kuvanga ibirungo.
Umulewi yitwa Matitiya, imfura ya Shalumu Umukorahi, yari ajejwe kwotsa imikate yo gutanga kw’amashikanwa.
Bamwe mu bavukanyi b’Abakohati bari bajejwe gutegura imikate yo gushirwa ku meza uko Isabato ishitse.
Abari bajejwe gucuraranga, abakuru b’amazu yo mu muryango w’Abalewi, baba mu vyumba vy’Ingoro kandi ntibahabwa ibindi bikorwa kuko bari bajejwe ico gikorwa ku murango no mw’ijoro.
Abo bose bari abakuru b’amazu yo mu muryango w’Abalewi, abatwara abandi nk’uko vyanditswe mu bitabu vy’urutonde rw’ingene bagiye bararondoka, kandi baba i Yerusalemu.
Yeyiyeli se wa Gibeyoni yaba i Gibeyoni. Umugore wiwe yitwa Mayaka,
kandi imfura yiwe yari Abudoni, agakurikirwa na Zuri, Kishi, Bayali, Neri, Nadabu,
Gedori, Ahiyo, Zakariya na Mikuloti.
Mikuloti yari se wa Shimeyami. Na bo nyene babana n’abo mu miryango y’iwabo i Yerusalemu.
Neri yari se wa Kishi, Kishi se wa Sawuli, Sawuli se wa Yonatani, Maluki-Shuwa, Abinadabu na Eshibayali.
Mwene Yonatani, ni Meribu-Bayali, na we akaba yavyaye Mika.
Bene Mika, ni Pitoni, Meleki, Tahireya na Ahazi.
Ahazi yari se wa Yada, Yada yari se wa Alemeti, Azimaveti na Zimuri; Zimuri na we akaba se wa Moza.
Moza yari se wa Bineya, Bineya ni se wa Refaya, Refaya se wa Eleyasa, Eleyasa se wa Azeli.
Azeli yari afise abahungu batandatu, kandi aya ni yo mazina yabo: Azurikamu, Bokeru, Ishimayeli, Sheyariya, Obadiya na Hanani. Abo bose bari bene Azeli.
Maze Abafilisitiya bagwanya Abisirayeli; Abisirayeli barata barahunga, kandi benshi muri bo bicirwa ku musozi Gilibowa.
Abafilisitiya babirukako basugereza Sawuli n’abahungu biwe, bica abahungu biwe Yonatani, Abinadabu na Maluki-Shuwa.
Maze Sawuli urugamba rumumerera nabi cane, abanyamiheto baramurasa baramukomeretsa.

Sawuli abwira uwari amutwaje ibigwanisho ati: “Sokora inkota yawe unsogote, kugira ngo izo ntakebwa ntizimfate ngo zinyice nabi.” Ariko uwamutwaza ibigwanisho aranka kuko yari afise ubwoba bwinshi. Nuko Sawuli afata inkota yiwe ayisukako.
Umwe yamutwaza ibigwanisho abonye ko Sawuli apfuye, na we nyene yisuka ku nkota yiwe arapfa.
Nuko Sawuli n’abahungu biwe batatu barapfa, n’abo mu nzu yiwe bose bagwa hamwe.
Abisirayeli bose bari mu kiyaya babonye ko ingabo zahunze kandi ko Sawuli n’abahungu biwe bapfuye, baca bata ibisagara vyabo barahunga. Maze Abafilisitiya baraza babibamwo.
Bukeye, Abafilisitiya baja aho urugamba rwabereye kwambura abapfuye ibigwanisho n’ibintu vyabo vy’agaciro, basanga Sawuli n’abahungu biwe baguye ku musozi Gilibowa.
Bamuca umutwe, bamwambura n’ibigwanisho vyiwe, baca barungika intumwa mu gihugu cose c’Abafilisitiya ngo bakwize iyo nkuru mu ngoro z’ibigirwamana vyabo no mu bantu.
Baca bashira ibigwanisho vyiwe mu ngoro y’ibigirwamana vyabo, umutwe wiwe bawumanika mu ngoro y’ikigirwamana Dagoni.
Maze ab’i Yabeshi Gileyadi bose bumvise ivyo Abafilisitiya bakoreye Sawuli vyose,
abagabo bose b’abahizi baragenda batora imivyimba ya Sawuli n’abahungu biwe bayijana i Yabeshi. Bahamba amagufa yabo musi y’igiti kinini i Yabeshi, baca bisonzesha kumara imisi indwi.
Nuko Sawuli apfa azize kutaba umwizigirwa k’ Uhoraho , kutazigama ijambo yabwiwe n’ Uhoraho no gusiguza uwuhamagara imizimu,
aho gusiguza Uhoraho . Nuko Uhoraho aramwica aca agabira ingoma yiwe Dawidi mwene Isayi.
Abisirayeli bose bakoranira i Heburoni aho Dawidi yari ari bamubwira bati: “Twebwe turi umubiri wawe n’amaraso yawe.

Kandi kera, mbere n’igihe Sawuli yari umwami, ni wewe warongora Abisirayeli mu ntambara. Kandi Uhoraho Imana yawe yarakubwiye ati: ‘Uzoba umwungere w’abantu banje b’Abisirayeli, kandi uzoba umutware wabo.’ ”

Abakuru bose b’Abisirayeli baja kuraba umwami Dawidi i Heburoni, aca agirana na bo isezerano aho nyene i Heburoni imbere y’ Uhoraho , baca bamurobanuza amavuta baramwimika ngo abe umwami w’Abisirayeli, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabisezeranye abicishije kuri Samweli.
Dawidi n’Abisirayeli bose baja i Yerusalemu ari ho hitwa Yebusi. Abayebusi baba ngaho
babwira Dawidi bati: “Ntuzoshobora kwinjira ngaha.” Ariko Dawidi yigarurira igice c’ahitwa Siyoni hazitijwe impome zikomeye, ari ho haciye hitwa Igisagara ca Dawidi.
Dawidi yari yavuze ati: “Umuntu wese azoba uwa mbere mu gutera Abayebusi akahafata azoca aba umukuru w’ingabo.” Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya aduga ubwa mbere, aca ahabwa kuba umukuru w’ingabo.
Dawidi aca ashira ikirimba ciwe aho hantu hazitiye kuri uwo musozi, haca hitwa Igisagara ca Dawidi.
Yubaka igisagara hirya no hino y’ikirimba, uhereye ku musezero w’ahitwa Milo ugashika ku ruzitiro. Ico gihe Yowabu yariko arasanura ahandi hose hasigaye h’ico gisagara.
Maze Dawidi arushaho kuba uwuhambaye, kuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yari kumwe na we.
Aba ni bo bari abakuru mu bahizi ba Dawidi; abo hamwe n’Abisirayeli bose, baterereye mu gushigikira ingoma yiwe kugira ngo ikwire mu gihugu cose, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabisezeranye.
Uru ni rwo rutonde rw’abahizi ba Dawidi: Yashobeyamu, wo mu muryango wa Hakumoni, yari umukuru yaganza abacungera ubuzima bw’umwami. Ni we yicishije icumu ryiwe abantu amajana atatu mu mwanya umwe.
Yakurikirwa na Eliyazeri mwene Dodayi Umwahohi, yari umwe muri bamwe batatu b’abahizi mu ntambara.
Yari kumwe na Dawidi i Pasi-Damimu mu ntambara y’Abafilisitiya. Urugamba rwabereye mu murima w’ingano, hanyuma ingabo z’Abisirayeli zihunga Abafilisitiya;
ariko Eleyazari na Dawidi bobo bahagarara hagati muri uwo murima barawugwanira, bica Abafilisitiya, Uhoraho abaha intsinzi ikomeye.
Batatu bo muri abo bahizi mirongo itatu baramanuka basanga Dawidi aho yari ari mw’isenga ry’ibuye i Adulamu. Ico gihe umugwi w’Abafilisitiya wari ucumbitse mu kiyaya c’i Refayimu.
Dawidi yari mu kinyegero, kandi umuce w’ingabo z’Abafilisitiya wari i Betelehemu.
Dawidi yumva agomba amazi, maze aca avuga ati: “Ese icompa hakagira uwunzanira amazi yo kunywa yo kw’iriba riri kw’irembo ry’i Betelehemu!”

Nuko bamwe batatu baragenda, baca hagati mu ngabo z’Abafilisitiya, bavoma ayo mazi kw’iriba ryari hafi y’irembo ry’i Betelehemu bayashira Dawidi. Ariko Dawidi yanka kuyanywa; ayasesa hasi imbere y’ Uhoraho .

Avuga ati: “Imana indinde gukora ikintu nk’ico! Mbega noshobora kunywa amaraso y’aba bantu bahevye amagara yabo?” Kuko bari bahevye amagara yabo mu kuja kumuzanira ayo mazi, bituma yanka kuyanywa. Ivyo vyagaragaje ubutwari bw’abo batatu b’abahizi mu ntambara.
Abishayi mwene nyina wa Yowabu yari umukuru wa bamwe batatu. Yishe abantu amajana atatu akoresheje icumu ryiwe, bituma aba rurangiranwa nka bamwe batatu.
Yahawe icubahiro kiruta ica bamwe mirongo itatu maze aca aba umukuru wabo, n’aho atari umwe muri bamwe batatu.

Benaya mwene Yehoyada yari umugwanyi w’umuhizi yava i Kabuzeyeli, kandi yakoze ibihambaye. Yishe abahizi babiri baruta abandi mu ngabo z’Abanyamowabu. Umusi umwe shelegi iriko iragwa, amanuka mu rwobo, yica intambwe.

Ni we yishe Umunyegiputa yari afise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’igihagararo. Naho uwo Munyegiputa yari afise mu minwe icumu rikwikiye mu ruti rungana n’umuhini, Benaya yagiye kumugwanya afise inkoni, amushikura rya cumu mu minwe, aba ari ryo amwicisha.
Ivyo ni vyo bikorwa vy’ubuhizi Benaya mwene Yehoyada yakoze; na we nyene yari rurangiranwa nka bamwe batatu.
Yari afise icubahiro kuruta bamwe mirongo itatu, ariko ntiyari uwo muri bamwe batatu. Maze Dawidi aca amugira umukuru w’abacungera umutekano wiwe.
Abo bahizi bari Asaheli murumuna wa Yowabu, Eluhanani mwene Dodo w’i Betelehemu,
Shamoti Umuharori, Helezi Umupeloni,
Ira mwene Ikeshi w’i Tekowa, Abiyezeri w’i Anatoti,
Sibekayi Umuhushati, Ilayi Umwahohi,
Maharayi w’i Netofati, Heledi mwene Bayana w’i Netofati,
Itayi mwene Ribayi w’i Gibeya mu Bubenyamini, Benaya w’i Piratoni,
Hurayi wo mu bihomoka vy’i Gayashi, Abiyeli Umwarubati,
Azumaveti Umubaharumi, Eliyaba Umushaluboni,
Bene Hashemi Umugizoni, Yonatani mwene Shageye Umuharari,
Ahiyamu mwene Sakari Umuharari, Elifali mwene Uri,
Heferi Umumekerati, Ahiya Umupeloni,
Heziro w’i Karumeli, Nayari mwene Ezubayi,
Yoweli yavukana na Natani, Mibari mwene Haguri,
Zeleki Umwamoni, Naharayi Umuberoti, uwatwaza Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya ibigwanisho,
Ira w’i Ituri, Garebu w’i Ituri,
Uriya Umuheti, Zabadi mwene Ahilayi,
Adina mwene Shiza Umureyubeni, yari umukuru w’Abareyubeni, na ba bandi mirongo itatu bari kumwe na we,
Hanani mwene Mayaka, Yoshafati w’i Mituni,
Uziya w’i Ashuterati, Shama na Yeyiyeli bene Hotamu w’i Aroweri,
Yediyayeli mwene Shimuri, umuvukanyi wiwe Yoha Umutizi,
Eliyeli Umumahawi, Yeribayi na Yoshaviya bene Elunayami, Ituma Umunyamowabu,
Eliyeli, Obedi na Yayasiyeli w’i Mezobayi.
Aba ni bo bagiye kwifatanya na Dawidi ari i Zikulagi, igihe yari yahunze Sawuli mwene Kishi: ni bo bamufashije urugamba;
bari bafise imiheto kandi bari bazi kurasa imyampi canke guteresha amabuye umugozi bakoresheje ukuryo canke ukubamfu; bari Ababenyamini bo mu muryango wa Sawuli:
Ahiyezeri umukuru wabo na Yowashi bene Shemaya Umunyagibeya; Yaziyeli na Peleti bene Azumaveti; Beraka, Yehu Umwanatoti,
na Ishimaya Umunyagibeyoni, umugabo w’inkomezi yari muri bamwe murongo itatu, akaba n’umukuru wabo; Yeremiya, Yahaziyeli, Yohanani, Yozabadi w’i Gedera,
Eluzayi, Yerimoti, Beyaliya, Shemariya na Shefatiya Umuharufi;
Elukana, Isishiya, Azareli, Yowezeri na Yashobeyamu Abakorahi;
na Yowela na Zebadiya bene Yerohamu w’i Gedori.

Bamwe mu bakomoka kuri Gadi bava kuri Sawuli baja kwifatanya na Dawidi aho yari yinyegeje mu bugaragwa. Bari abahizi b’inkomezi, biteguriye kugwana kandi bazi gukoresha inkinzo n’icumu. Mu maso habo hari hateye ubwoba nk’ah’intambwe, kandi banyaruka nk’ingeregere iyo ziruka ku misozi.
Ezeri ni we yari umukuru wabo, Obadiya akaba icegera ciwe, Eliyabu akaba uwa gatatu,
Mishumana uwa kane, Yeremiya uwa gatanu,
Atayi uwa gatandatu, Eliyeli uw’indwi,
Yohanani uw’umunani, Elizabadi uw’icenda,
Yeremiya uw’icumi, Makubanayi na we uw’icumi na rimwe.
Abo Bagadi bari abakuru b’ingabo; uwa nyuma mu nkomezi yashobora kugwana n’abantu ijana, umunyenkomezi kurusha abandi na we yashobora kugwana n’abantu igihumbi.
Abo ni bo bajabutse Yorodani mu kwezi kwa mbere igihe rwari rwuzuye rwarenze inkombe, baca bakinagiza abantu bose baba mu biyaya vyaho babashwiragiriza mu buseruko no mu burengero bw’urwo ruzi.
Abandi Babenyamini na bamwe mu Bayuda na bo baraza bifatanya na Dawidi aho yari yinyegeje.

Dawidi arasohoka ahura na bo maze arababwira ati: “nimwaba muzanywe n’amahoro, no kumfasha, nditeguye kwifatanya namwe. Ariko nimwaba muzanywe no kungurisha ku bansi banje kandi ata kibi kinyagira, Imana ya ba sogokuruza nibibone hanyuma ibacire urubanza.”

Maze Mpwemu aza kuri Amasayi, yarongora bamwe mirongo itatu, aravuga ati: “Turi abawe, yewe Dawidi! Turi kumwe nawe, yewe mwene Isayi! Gira amahoro no kuroranirwa, n’abagushigikiye bose batere baja imbere, kuko Imana yawe igushigikiye.” Nuko Dawidi arabakira abagira abakuru b’abagwanyi biwe.

Bamwe mu bakomoka kuri Manase bava mu ngabo za Isirayeli baja kwifatanya na Dawidi igihe yajana n’Abafilisitiya kugwanya Sawuli. We n’abantu biwe ntibafashije Abafilisitiya kuko abatware b’Abafilisitiya bamaze kugira inama, baciye bamusubiza inyuma. Bavuze bati: “Hamwe yokwihindukiza agasubiza hamwe na shebuja Sawuli, twohasiga agatwe.”

Igihe Dawidi yari asubiye i Zikulagi, ni ho abakomoka kuri Manase baja kwifatanya na we, ari bo: Adina, Yozabadi, Yediyayeli, Mikayeli, Yozabadi, Elihu na Ziletayi. Umwe wese yari arongoye umugwi w’ingabo igihumbi mu Bamanase.
Bafasha Dawidi kugwanya abansi biwe, kuko bari abagwanyi b’abahizi, kandi bari abakuru b’ingabo mu ngabo ziwe.
Ku musi ku musi abantu baguma baza kwifatanya na Dawidi, gushika aho yagize ingabo nyinshi, nk’ingabo z’Imana.
Ibi ni vyo bitigiri vy’ingabo zambaye ibigwanisho ziteguriye kuja ku rugamba zaje kuri Dawidi i Heburoni kugira ngo zimuhe ubwami bwari ubwa Sawuli, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yaravuze:
Abo mu muryango wa Yuda, haje ibihumbi bitandatu n’amajana umunani biteguriye kuja ku rugamba bitwaje amacumu n’inkinzo.
Abo mu muryango wa Simeyoni, haje abagwanyi biteguriye kuja ku rugamba, ibihumbi indwi n’ijana;
Abo mu muryango wa Lewi, haje ibihumbi bine n’amajana atandatu,
harimwo na Yehoyada, umukuru w’umuryango wa Aroni, yari afise abantu ibihumbi bitatu n’amajana indwi arongoye,
hamwe na Sadoki, umugwanyi w’umuhizi akiri muto, yazananye n’abakuru b’ingabo mirongo ibiri na babiri, bo mu muryango wiwe.
Abo mu muryango wa Benyamini, ari wo muryango wa Sawuli, haje ibihumbi bitatu benshi muri bo bari bagumye bayoboka inzu ya Sawuli gushika ico gihe.
Abo mu muryango wa Efurayimu, abagwanyi b’abahizi, ba rurangiranwa mu nzu zabo, haje ibihumbi mirongo ibiri n’amajana umunani.
Abo mu gice c’umuryango wa Manase, co mu burengero bwa Yorodani batowe baravye amazina yabo ngo baje kwimika Dawidi, bose hamwe bari ibihumbi cumi n’umunani.
Abo mu muryango wa Isakari, bari abantu bazi kugenzura ibihe kandi bagatahura ico Abisirayeli bategerezwa gukora, baje ari amajana abiri, hamwe n’abagenzi babo batwara.

Abo mu muryango wa Zebuloni, abasoda bamenyereye ivy’intambara kandi biteguriye kuja ku rugamba no gukoresha ibigwanisho vy’uburyo bwose, ngo bafashe Dawidi n’umutima wabo wose, haje ibihumbi mirongo itanu.
Abo mu muryango wa Nafutali, baje ari igihumbi, bari abakuru b’ingabo ibihumbi mirongo itatu n’indwi batwara inkinzo n’amacumu.
Abo mu muryango wa Dani, biteguye kuja mu rugamba, baje ari ibihumbi mirongo ibiri n’umunani n’amajana atandatu.
Abo mu muryango wa Asheri, abasoda bamenyereye ivy’intambara kandi biteguriye kuja ku rugamba, baje ari ibihumbi mirongo ine.
Abaje bava hakurya ya Yorodani, ahaba abakomoka kuri Reyubeni, Gadi n’igice c’umuryango wa Manase, bari ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ibiri bambaye ibigwanisho vy’uburyo bwose.
Abo bagwanyi bose baje bafise umutima umwe kandi ukunze kugira ngo bimike Dawidi abe umwami wa Isirayeli. Mbere n’abandi Bisirayeli bose basigaye baremeza ko Dawidi ari we akwiye kubabera umwami.
Abo bantu bamara imisi itatu bari kumwe na Dawidi, barya banywa, kuko imiryango yabo yari yabagemuriye.

Vyongeye, n’abo hirya no hino gushika no mu Bisakari, Abazebuloni no mu Banafutali baraza bazanye ivyokurya ku ndogoba, ku ngamiya, ku nyumbu, no ku nka. Hariho n’ibintu vyinshi bigizwe n’ifu, n’insukoni zikaranze, inzabibu zikaranze, umuvinyu, amavuta, inka n’intama, kuko hari umunezero mwinshi mu Bisirayeli.

headings.text: Abandi bifatanije na Dawidi i Heburoni

verses.text: Dawidi avugana n’abakuru barongoye abandi, abarongoye imice y’ingabo igihumbi n’abarongoye imice y’ingabo ijana.

Maze abwira Abisirayeli bose ati: “Nivyaba bibahimbaye kandi ari ubugombe bw’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, reka dutume intumwa ku bari kure n’abari hafi benewanyu bari mu bice vyose vya Isirayeli, no ku baherezi n’Abalewi bari kumwe na bo mu bisagara vyabo n’uburagiro bwavyo, baze bafatanye natwe.
Tugende tugarukane iwacu Isandugu y’Imana yacu, kuko tutigeze tuvyitaho ku ngoma ya Sawuli.”
Ikoraniro ryose riremera ko bakora uko, kuko abantu bose babonye ko ari vyiza.
Nuko Dawidi akoranya Abisirayeli bose, kuva ku ruzi Shihori ari ko kagezi ka Egiputa gushika i Lebo-Hamati, ngo baje kuzana Isandugu y’Imana yari i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu.
Dawidi n’Abisirayeli bose bajana na we i Bayala h’i Buyuda, ari ho Kiriyati-Yeyarimu, kugira ngo bakureyo isandugu y’ Uhoraho Imana, ivyagiye hagati y’abakerubi, isandugu yitirirwa rya Zina.
Bakura isandugu y’Imana mu nzu kwa Abinadabu iri ku mukogote mushasha, Uza na Ahiyo bayoboye uwo mukogote.
Dawidi n’Abisirayeli bose bariko bariginagura imbere y’Imana n’inkomezi zabo zose, baririmba bavuza inanga, amakembe, udushako tw’ingoma, inzumbete n’ibindi bicurarangisho.
Bashitse ku mbuga yo kugosorerako ya Kidoni, Uza agorora ukuboko kwiwe ngo asame iyo sandugu, kuko impfizi zikwega uwo mukogote zari zitsitaye.
Uhoraho ashavurira cane Uza, maze aramukubita arapfa kuko akoze kuri iyo sandugu. Nuko aca apfira ngaho nyene imbere y’Imana.
Maze Dawidi arashavura kuko Uhoraho yarakiye Uza. Aca yita aho hantu Perezi-Uza, bisigura “gushavurira Uza”; kandi ni ko hacitwa kugeza n’uno musi.
Dawidi aca atinya Imana kuri uwo musi, maze arabaza ati: “Mbega noshobora nte kuzana Isandugu y’Imana iwanje?”
Ntiyatwara iyo Sandugu ngo ije mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, ariko aca ayikebereza mu nzu kwa Obedi-Edomu w’i Gati.
Iyo Sandugu y’Imana iguma mu nzu kwa Obedi-Edomu no mu muryango wiwe amezi atatu, maze Uhoraho ahezagira umuryango wa Obedi-Edomu n’ivyo ari atunze vyose.

headings.text: Bimura Isandugu y’Isezerano yari i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu

verses.text: Maze Hiramu umwami w’i Tiro arungika intumwa kwa Dawidi, azirungikana n’ibiti vy’amasederi, n’abubatsi bubakisha amabuye n’ababaji bo kumwubakira ikirimba.
Maze Dawidi aca amenya ko Uhoraho yemeje ko ari we mwami w’Abisirayeli bose kandi ko yashize hejuru ubwami bwiwe kubera abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli.
Dawidi arongorera i Yerusalemu abandi bagore, avyara abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Aya ni yo mazina y’abana yavyariye i Yerusalemu: Shamuwa, Shobabu, Natani, Salomo,
Ibuhari, Elishuwa, Elupeleti,
Nogahu, Nefegi, Yafiya,
Elishama, Beyeliyada na Elifeleti.
Abafilisitiya bumvise ko Dawidi yasizwe amavuta ngo abe umwami w’Abisirayeli bose, baraduga n’inkomezi zabo zose bagiye kumurondera ngo bamufate; ariko Dawidi avyumvise aca aja guhura na bo.
Maze Abafilisitiya barashika bacumbika mu kiyaya c’i Refayimu;
Dawidi aca asiguza Imana ati: “Mbega nje gutera Abafilisitiya? Urabampa mu maboko yanje?” Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Genda, nzobatanga mu maboko yawe.”

Nuko Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe baraduga baja i Bayali-Perazimu, kandi aho ni ho yabaneshereje. Aravuga ati: “Imana yansaturiye inzira mu bansi banje ikoresheje ukuboko kwanje nk’uko amazi asenyura urugomero.” Ni co catumye aho hantu hitwa Bayali-Perazimu.
Abafilisitiya bari batayeho ibigirwamana vyabo, maze Dawidi aca atanga itegeko ngo babiturire.
Ikindi gihe Abafilisitiya bongera gucumbika mu kiyaya;
maze Dawidi yongera kubaza Imana ico yokora, na yo iramwishura iti: “Ntubatere ubaturutse imbere, ariko ubazunguruke ubatere ubaturutse inyuma aharabana na biriya biti vy’imibaka.
Niwumva imirindi mu bushorishori bw’ivyo biti, uce utangura kubagwanya, kuko Imana izoba ikugiye imbere kugwanya ingabo z’Abafilisitiya.”
Nuko Dawidi akora nk’uko Imana yamutegetse, maze bica ingabo z’Abafilisitiya kuva i Gibeyoni gushika i Gezeri.
Nuko Dawidi aba rurangiranwa mu gihugu cose, kandi Uhoraho atuma ibihugu vyose bimutinya.

headings.text: Abo mu nzu ya Dawidi n’umuryango wiwe

verses.text: Dawidi amaze kwubaka inyubakwa ziwe mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, aca ategura ikibanza c’Isandugu y’Imana, ayishingira ihema.
Maze Dawidi aravuga ati: “Nta muntu n’umwe atari Umulewi akwiye guterura Isandugu y’Imana, kuko Uhoraho yabatoranirije kurerura iyo Sandugu yiwe no kwama bamukorera bari imbere yiwe ibihe bidashira.”
Dawidi akoranya Abisirayeli bose i Yerusalemu ngo badugane Isandugu y’ Uhoraho bayizane mu kibanza yari yayiteguriye.
Ahamagara abo mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni n’Abalewi:
Abo mu nzu ya Kohati, Uriyeli umukuru wabo hamwe na benewabo ijana na mirongo ibiri;
abo mu nzu ya Merari, Asaya umukuru wabo hamwe na benewabo amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri;
abo mu nzu ya Gerishomu, Yoweli umukuru wabo hamwe na benewabo ijana na mirongo itatu;
abo mu nzu ya Elizafani, Shemaya umukuru wabo hamwe na benewabo amajana abiri;
abo mu nzu ya Heburoni, Eliyeli umukuru wabo hamwe na benewabo mirongo umunani;
abo mu ya Uziyeli, Aminadabu umukuru wabo hamwe na benewabo ijana na cumi na babiri.
Hanyuma Dawidi atumako Sadoki na Abiyatari abaherezi, na Uriyeli, Asaya, Yoweli, Shemaya, Eliyeli na Aminadabu Abalewi.

Arababwira ati: “Ni mwebwe bakuru b’inzu zigize umuryango w’Abalewi; mwebwe na bagenzi banyu b’Abalewi nimwiyeze kugira ngo muje kudugana Isandugu y’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, muyizane mu kibanza nayitunganirije.
Kubera yuko, mwebwe Abalewi, mutayireruye ca gihe ni co catumye Uhoraho Imana yacu aturakira. Ntitwamusiguje ngo atubwire uko yavuze bizohora bikorwa.”
Nuko abaherezi n’Abalewi bariyeza kugira ngo baje kudugana Isandugu y’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Kandi Abalewi barerura Isandugu y’Imana iri ku biti bibiri biteruwe n’abantu bane ku bitugu vyabo, nk’uko Mose yari yarabitegetse yisunze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .
Dawidi abwira abakuru bo mu Balewi ngo batoranye muri bagenzi babo b’abaririmvyi abo kuririmba indirimbo z’umunezero, bavuza n’ibicurarangisho: amakembe, inanga n’udushako tw’ingoma.
Maze Abalewi batoranya Hemani mwene Yoweli; mu bavukanyi biwe, Asafu mwene Berekiya; no muri benewabo b’Abamerari, Etani mwene Kushaya;
bari kumwe na benewabo bo ku rwego rwa kabiri: Zakariya, Yayaziyeli, Shemiramoti, Yehiyeli, Uni, Eliyabu, Benaya, Mayaseya, Matitiya, Elifelehu, Mikuneya, Obedi-Edomu na Yeyiyeli, abarinzi b’irembo.
Abacuraranzi Hemani, Asafu na Etani bavuza ivyuma vy’imiringa;
Zakariya, Aziyeli, Shemiramoti, Yehiyeli, Uni, Eliyabu, Mayaseya na Benaya bacuraranga amakembe mw’ijwi ryitwa alamoti,
nayo Matitiya, Elifelehu, Mikuneya, Obedi-Edomu, Yeyiyeli na Azaziya bavuza inanga, mw’ijwi ryitwa Sheminite.
Kenaniya umukuru w’Abalewi yari arongoye abaririmvyi, kuko yari umuhinga muri vyo.
Berekiya na Elukana bari abarinzi b’urugi rw’ihema ry’isandugu.

Shebaniya, Yoshafati, Netaneli, Amasayi, Zakariya, Benaya na Eliyezeri abaherezi bari bashinzwe kuvuza inzamba imbere y’Isandugu y’Imana. Obedi-Edomu na Yehiya na bo nyene bari bashinzwe kurinda umuryango w’isandugu.
Nuko Dawidi n’abakuru bose b’Abisirayeli n’intwazangabo zirongoye ingabo igihumbihumbi, bagenda kudugana Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho bayikura mu nzu kwa Obedi-Edomu, bari n’umunezero mwinshi.
Kandi kubera ko Imana yafashije Abalewi bari bareruye iyo Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho , baciye batanga ibimazi vy’amashuri y’inka indwi n’amapfizi y’intama indwi.

Muri ico gihe Dawidi yari yambaye ikanzu yera derere, co kimwe n’Abalewi bose bari bareruye iyo Sandugu, n’abaririmvyi, na Kenaniya umukuru w’imigwi y’abaririmvyi; kandi Dawidi yari yambaye na efodi yera.

Nuko Abisirayeli bose badugana iyo Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho batera akamo k’umunezero, bavuza inzamba zikozwe mu mahembe y’intama n’inzumbete, n’ivyuma bivuzwa bigasama, bavuza n’amakembe n’inanga.
Maze Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho yinjiye mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, Mikali umukobwa wa Sawuli abirabira mw’idirisha. Abonye umwami Dawidi atamba yiginagura, amugayira mu mutima.
Maze bazana ya Sandugu y’Imana bayinjiza muri rya hema Dawidi yari yarayiteguriye, hanyuma batanga ibimazi biturirwa n’umuriro hamwe n’ivy’ishimwe imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Ahejeje gutanga ivyo bimazi biturirwa n’umuriro n’ivy’ishimwe, ahezagira abantu mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho .
Aca aha Umwisirayeli wese, yaba umugabo canke umugore, umukate, inyama n’akandi gakate gakozwe mu nzabibu.
Aca atoranya bamwe mu Balewi ngo bakorere imbere y’Isandugu y’ Uhoraho , bambaze, bashime, bahimbaze Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli:

Asafu ni we yari umukuru, Zakariya akaba uwa kabiri, hanyuma Yeyiyeli, Shemiramoti, Yehiyeli, Matitiya, Eliyabu, Benaya, Obedi-Edomu na Yeyiyeli. Bari bashinzwe kuvuza amakembe n’inanga, Asafu akavuza ivyuma bisama,
Benaya na Yahaziyeli abaherezi na bo bakavuza inzamba uko igihe cagenywe gishitse imbere y’Isandugu y’Isezerano y’Imana.
Kuri uwo musi Dawidi ashinga ubwa mbere Asafu n’abo bari bafatanije ngo baririmbe iyi ndirimbo yo gutanga ishimwe k’ Uhoraho :
Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , mwamamaze izina ryiwe; mumenyekanishe mu mahanga ivyo yakoze.
Nimumuririmbire, mumuhimbaze; muvuge ibikorwa vyiwe bihambaye.
Mwirate izina ryiwe ryera; imitima y’abarondera Uhoraho inezerwe.
Nimurondere Uhoraho n’inkomezi ziwe; mwame murondera mu nyonga hiwe.
Nimwibuke ibitangaza yakoze, utwumiza, n’imanza yaciye;
Yemwe ruvyaro rwa Isirayeli, umusavyi wayo; yemwe bene Yakobo, abo yatoranije.
Uhoraho ni we Mana yacu; imanza ziwe ziri mw’isi yose.
Nimwibuke isezerano ryiwe ibihe vyose, n’ijambo yasezeranye, gushika ku runganwe rugira igihumbi,
Isezerano yagiranye na Aburahamu, indahiro yarahiye Isaka.
Yararyemeje kuri Yakobo nk’itegeko, no kuri Isirayeli nk’isezerano ry’intahava ngo:
“Nzoguha igihugu c’i Kanani, kibe umugabane wawe uzoragwa.”
Igihe bari bakiri inkehwa gusa, mbere ari inkehwa vy’ukuri, kandi ari inyambukira muri co,
Bagenda bangara bava mu gihugu baja mu kindi, bava mu bwami baja mu bundi.
Ntiyakundira umuntu n’umwe kubacinyiza; ku bwabo yakankamiye abami ati:
“Ntimukore ku bo narobanuje amavuta; ntimugirire nabi abavugishwa banje.”
Yemwe abari mw’isi mwese, muririmbire Uhoraho , mwamamaze agakiza kiwe uko bukeye,
Muvuge ivy’icubahiro ciwe mu mahanga yose, n’ibitangaza yakoze mu moko yose.
Kuko Uhoraho ahambaye kandi abereye gushimwa; akwiye kwubahwa kuruta ibigirwamana vyose.
Kuko imana zose z’amahanga ari ibigirwamana, ariko Uhoraho yaremye amajuru.
Ubwiza n’icubahiro biri imbere yiwe; inkomezi n’umunezero biri mu ngoro yiwe.
Nimwemere Uhoraho , yemwe miryango yose yo mu mahanga, mwemere ko Uhoraho afise icubahiro n’inkomezi.
Nimuhe Uhoraho icubahiro kibereye izina ryiwe; Muzane ishikanwa, mushike mu birimba vyiwe. Musenge Uhoraho muri mu bwiza bw’ukwera kwiwe.
Yemwe abari mw’isi mwese, muhindire agashitsi imbere yiwe! Isi irashimangiye; ntishobora kunyiganyizwa.
Ijuru nirinezerwe, isi nihimbarwe; nibivuge mu mahanga yose biti: “ Uhoraho araganje!”
Ikiyaga nikibomborane, n’ibiri muri co vyose; imirima yose nivyine, n’ibiri muri yo vyose!
Maze ibiti vyo mw’ishamba bizoririmba. Bizoririmbishwa n’umunezero mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , kuko aje gucira isi urubanza.
Nimushime Uhoraho kuko ari mwiza; kuko urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Nimutakambe muti: “Dukize, yewe Mana y’agakiza kacu; twegeranye udukure mu mahanga, kugira ngo dushime izina ryawe ryera, twongere tuguhimbaze.”
Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, ahimbazwe Uhereye ibihe bidashira ukageza ibihe bidashira. Maze abantu bose baritabira bati: “Amen”; bongerako bati: “Dutazire Uhoraho.”
Dawidi aca ashinga ko Asafu n’abo bari kumwe imbere y’Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho bazoguma aho bayikorera imisi yose, nk’uko vyari bitegekanijwe ku musi ku musi.
Ashinga ko Obedi-Edomu mwene Yedutuni, na Hosa, n’abandi Balewi mirongo itandatu n’umunani, baba abarinzi b’irembo.
Dawidi ashinga ko Sadoki umuherezi na bagenzibe b’abaherezi bama imbere y’ihema ry’ Uhoraho ku mpinga y’umusozi i Gibeyoni
ngo bashikanire Uhoraho ibimazi vyo guturirirwa ku gicaniro bashikanirako ibimazi vyo ku musi ku musi, nk’uko vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe Uhoraho yahawe Abisirayeli.
Abandi bari kumwe na bo ni Hemani na Yedutuni n’abandi bose bari baratoranijwe uko amazina yabo ari ngo bashime Uhoraho bavuga bati: “Kuko urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.”
Hemani na Yedutuni bari bashinzwe kuvuza inzamba n’ivyuma bisama no kuvuza ibindi bicurarangisho mu kuririmba indirimbo z’Imana. Bene Yedutuni bahabwa igikorwa co gucungera irembo.
Nuko abantu bose barataha, umwe wese aja iwe, Dawidi na we asubira iwe ahezagira umuryango wiwe.
Dawidi amaze gushika neza mu ngoro iwe, abwira Natani uwavugishwa n’Imana ati: “Ehe raba, jewe mba mu nzu yubatswe n’ibiti vy’amasederi, nayo Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho iba mw’ihema.”
Natani yishura Dawidi ati: “Ivyo wiyumvira gukora vyose, genda ubikore kuko Imana iri kumwe nawe.”
Ariko muri iryo joro, ijambo ry’Imana riza kuri Natani riti:
“Genda ubwire umusavyi wanje Dawidi uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Si wewe uzonyubakira inzu yo kubamwo.
Sinigeze mba mu nzu kuva igihe nakuriye Abisirayeli muri Egiputa gushika uwu musi. Namye nimuka mva mu kibanza kimwe nja mu kindi, nkibera mw’ihema.
Ahantu hose nimukiye ndi kumwe n’Abisirayeli bose, hari aho nigeze mbwira umutware n’umwe mu barongozi nabahaye ngo baragire ubwoko bwanje nti: Ni kuki mutanyubakira inzu mu biti vy’amasederi?’
None rero, genda ubwire umusavyi wanje Dawidi uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: nagukuye mu bwungere aho waragira intama, ndagutoranya ngo ube uwuganza abantu banje b’Abisirayeli.
Nabanye nawe aho wagiye hose, kandi naherengeteje abansi bawe imbere yawe. None ngira nkuze izina ryawe ribe nk’amazina y’abahambaye bo kw’isi.

Kandi nzoha abantu banje b’Abisirayeli aho kuba, ndabateragire ahantu hatekanye ngo bagire inzu yabo bwite, aho batazokwongera kuburagizwa. Abansi babo ntibazosubira kubacinyiza nk’uko bahora babigira kera,

canke nk’uko bamye babikora uhereye igihe nashiraho abacamanza bo kurongora abantu banje b’Abisirayeli. Kandi nzocisha bugufi abansi bawe bose. Kandi ikirenze kuri ivyo, ndakumenyesheje ko ari Uhoraho azokwubakira inzu.
Imisi yawe niyashira ugahamvya ba sogokuruza, nzohagurutsa uwo mu ruvyaro rwawe wo kugusubirira ku ngoma, umwe wo mu bahungu bawe wivyariye, kandi nzokomeza ubwami bwiwe.
Uwo ni we azonyubakira ingoro, nanje nzokomeza ingoma yiwe ibihe bidashira.
Nzomubera se, na we azombera umwana. Kandi sinzokwigera ndamukurako urukundo rwanje, nka kurya narukuye ku wo wasubiriye ku ngoma.
Nzomuzeza inzu yanje n’ubwami bwanje ibihe vyose; intebe y’inganji yiwe izokwama ihangamye ibihe bidashira.”
Nuko Natani aragenda ashikiriza Dawidi ayo majambo yose y’uko guhishurirwa.
Nuko umwami Dawidi arinjira yicara imbere y’ Uhoraho , maze avuga ati: “Jewe ndi iki, yewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, kandi n’umuryango wanje wari iki, ko wanshikanye aha hose?
Kandi nk’aho umenga ivyo vyose ntivyari bihagije mu nyonga zawe ga Mana, warongeyeko uvuga ivya kazoza k’inzu y’umusavyi wawe. Wewe Uhoraho Mana, wandavye nk’uko umenga ndi hejuru y’abandi bose.
Mbega jewe Dawidi ikindi novuga ni iki ku vy’icubahiro wampaye jewe umusavyi wawe? Kuko urazi umusavyi wawe,
yewe Uhoraho . Wakoze iki kintu gihambaye, wongera umenyesha amasezerano yawe ahambaye nk’uko wabigomvye.
Nta n’umwe asa nawe Uhoraho , kandi nta yindi Mana atari wewe, nk’uko twavyiyumviye n’amatwi yacu.

Kandi ni irihe hanga kw’isi yose rimeze nk’abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli; ihanga wewe Imana wihagurukiye ukaja gucungura kugira ngo ribe iryo wiharije; kandi kugira ngo wiheshe icubahiro, ugakora ibihambaye biteye ubwoba, ukirukana amahanga imbere y’abantu bawe wacunguye ukabakura muri Egiputa?
Wahinduye abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli kuba abo wiharije ibihe vyose, kandi nawe Uhoraho , wahindutse Imana yabo.
None rero, Uhoraho , ivyo wasezeraniye umusavyi wawe n’inzu yiwe uze ubikomeze kugeza ibihe vyose. Uze ukore nk’uko wasezeranye,

kugira ngo bishike kandi izina ryawe ribe irihambaye ibihe bidashira. Maze abantu bazovuge bati: ‘ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana iganza Abisirayeli, ni yo Mana y’Abisirayeli!’ Kandi n’inzu y’umusavyi wawe Dawidi izokomerera imbere yawe.
Ewe Mana yanje, wahishuriye umusavyi wawe ko uzomwubakira inzu. Ni co catumye umusavyi wawe nterwa intege zo kugusenga.
None rero Uhoraho , uri Imana! Wasezeraniye umusavyi wawe ibi vyiza bingana bityo.
Vyaguhimbaye guha umugisha inzu y’umusavyi wawe, ngo izohore iri imbere yawe ibihe vyose; kuko ubwawe, yewe Uhoraho wayihezagiye, kandi izokwama ihezagiwe ibihe vyose.”
Inyuma y’ivyo, Dawidi atera Abafilisitiya arabanesha, maze afata Gati n’imihana ihakikije abikura mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya.
Dawidi arongera anesha Abanyamowabu, bacika abagurano biwe bakama bamuzanira amashikanwa yo kumwisaba.
Vyongeye, Dawidi agwanya Hadadezeri umwami w’i Zoba aramunesha gushika i Hamati, mu gihe Hadadezeri yari agiye gukomeza inganji yiwe mu karere k’uruzi Efurate.

Dawidi amunyaga imikogote igihumbi, abayigenderamwo ibihumbi indwi n’abasoda bagwanira ku maguru ibihumbi mirongo ibiri. Acagagura ibinono vy’amafarasi akwega iyo mikogote, asigaza ayo gukwega imikogote ijana gusa.
Maze Abaramu b’i Damasiko baja gutabara Hadadezeri umwami w’i Zoba, Dawidi abicamwo abantu ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri.
Aca ashinga ibirindiro i Damasiko ku mugwa mukuru w’i Siriya kandi Abaramu bacika abagurano biwe, bakama bamuzanira amashikanwa yo kumwisaba. Uhoraho yama aha Dawidi intsinzi aho yaja hose.
Dawidi afata inkinzo z’inzahabu zari iz’intwazangabo za Hadadezeri, azijana i Yerusalemu.

Mu bisagara vy’i Tibuhati n’i Kuni vyari ivya Hadadezeri, Dawidi ahanyaga ubutare bwinshi bw’umwakaka, ubwo Salomo yakoresheje mu kwubaka ibesani nini y’umwakaka bita ikiyaga, inkingi n’ibindi bikoresho vyari bikozwe muri ubwo butare.
Maze Towu umwami w’i Hamati yumvise ko Dawidi yanesheje ingabo zose za Hadadezeri umwami w’i Zoba,

aca arungika umuhungu wiwe Hadoramu ku mwami Dawidi kumuramutsa no kumukeza, kuko yanesheje Hadadezeri yahora yama amugwanya. Hadoramu ajana ibikoresho vy’ubwoko bwinshi, vy’inzahabu n’ivy’ifeza n’ivy’umwakaka.

Umwami Dawidi aca yegurira Uhoraho ivyo bikoresho vyose, nk’uko yari yabigize ku nzahabu n’ifeza yari yakuye muri ivyo bihugu vyose ari vyo vy’Abanyedomu, Abanyamowabu, Abamoni, Abafilisitiya n’Abamaleki.
Abishayi mwene Zeruwiya yica Abanyedomu ibihumbi cumi n’umunani mu Kiyaya c’Umunyu.
Ashira ibirindiro mu gihugu ca Edomu, kandi Abanyedomu bose baca baba abagurano ba Dawidi. Uhoraho yama aha intsinzi Dawidi aho yaja hose.
Dawidi aganza Abisirayeli bose, akora ibibereye n’ibigororotse ku bantu biwe bose.
Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya ni we yari umukuru w’ingabo; Yehoshafati mwene Ahiludi na we yari umwanditsi w’ivyaja biraba;
Sadoki mwene Ahitubu na Abimeleki mwene Abiyatari bari abaherezi; Shavisha yari umunyamabanga;
Benaya mwene Yehoyada yari ajejwe Abakereti n’Abapeleti; kandi abahungu ba Dawidi bari abahanuzi bakuru b’umwami.

headings.text: Abatware bo mu bwami bwa Dawidi

verses.text: Hanyuma y’ivyo, Nahashi umwami w’Abamoni arapfa, maze umuhungu wiwe amusubirira ku ngoma.

Dawidi ariyumvira ati: “Nzogirira neza Hanuni mwene Nahashi, kuko se yangiriye neza.” Nuko Dawidi atuma intumwa ngo zije kugarukira kuri Hanuni kuko yari yabuze se. Ba bantu ba Dawidi bashitse kwa Hanuni mu gihugu c’Abamoni kumwirura,

abaganwa b’Abamoni babwira Hanuni bati: “Wibaza ko Dawidi yubashe so mu kukurungikira abantu ngo bakugarukireko? Abantu biwe ubwo ntibazanywe no kugenzura igihugu no kuraba ingene kimeze ngo baze bagitere?”
Nuko Hanuni afata ba bantu ba Dawidi, abamwa umushatsi, asatura impuzu zabo uhereye aho itako ritangurira, aca arabarungika.

Haza abantu babwira Dawidi ivyashikiye abo bagabo, aca arungika intumwa ngo zihure na bo, kuko bari buzuye ibiteterwe. Umwami abatumako ati: “Nimugume i Yeriko gushika aho ubwanwa bwanyu buzokurira, hanyuma muze mubone kugaruka.”

Abamoni babonye ko bakoze ikintu giteye isoni imbere ya Dawidi, Hanuni n’Abamoni baca barungika italanto igihumbi z’ifeza i Aramu-Naharayimu, Aramu-Mayaka n’i Zoba kugira ngo babahe imikogote n’abayikoresha mu ntambara.

Bakotesha ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bibiri vy’imikogote n’abayigwanisha, hamwe n’umwami w’i Mayaka n’ingabo ziwe, baraza bacumbika hafi y’i Medeba, Abamoni na bo bariko barasohoka mu bisagara vyabo baja gutonda urugamba.
Dawidi avyumvise, aca arungika Yowabu n’ingabo zose zizi kugwana.
Abamoni baragenda batonda urugamba kw’irembo ry’igisagara, abami bari baje na bo bari ku musozi inyuma y’igisagara.
Yowabu abona ko urugamba rumuturutse imbere n’inyuma; aca atoranya bamwe mu ngabo z’indobanurwa mu Bisirayeli abarungika ngo bagwanye Abarameya.
Abasigaye abazeza murumunawe Abishayi ngo abatware, aca abatuma kugwanya Abamoni.
Yowabu amubwira ati: “Abarameya nibandusha inkomezi, uce uza kuntabara; ariko Abamoni nibakurusha inkomezi, ndagutabara.
Nureme kandi tugwane rugabo, tugwanire ihanga ryacu n’ibisagara vy’Imana yacu. Uhoraho ari bukore ivyo abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe.”
Maze Yowabu n’ingabo bari kumwe baragenda ngo bagwane n’Abarameya, na bo barabahunga.
Abamoni babonye ko Abarameya bariko barahunga, na bo nyene baca bahunga murumunawe Abishayi binjira mu gisagara. Maze Yowabu aca yisubirira i Yerusalemu.
Abarameya babonye ko baneshejwe n’Abisirayeli, batumako abandi Barameya bo hakurya y’uruzi Efurate, barongowe na Shofaki umukuru w’ingabo za Hadadezeri.
Dawidi avyumvise, akoranya Abisirayeli bose bajabuka Yorodani; batonda urugamba ngo babagwanye. Dawidi atondesha ingabo ngo zihangane n’Abarameya, na bo baraza bagwana na we.
Ariko Abarameya bahunga Abisirayeli, kandi Dawidi yica ibihumbi indwi mu bagwanira ku mikogote n’ibihumbi mirongo ine vy’abagwanira ku maguru. Yica na Shofaki umukuru w’ingabo zabo.
Abari barongowe na Hadadezeri babonye ko baneshejwe n’Abisirayeli, baca bisaba Dawidi bemera kuba abagurano biwe. Maze Abarameya ntibasubira kwiyumvira gutabara Abamoni.

Mu gihe imvura yaba itanguye kugabanuka hakaza ici, ni ho abami bahora baja mu ntambara. Yowabu arongora ingabo, aja gutera igihugu c’Abamoni arakinesha; ariko Dawidi yigumira i Yerusalemu. Yowabu yugariza igisagara c’i Raba arakinesha, agihindura umusaka.

Dawidi amaze gushika afata urugori rw’ubwami rwari ku mutwe w’umwami waho, asanga rupima italanto imwe y’inzahabu, kandi rwari rusharijwe n’utubuye tw’agaciro, baca barwambika Dawidi. Atwara iminyago myinshi akuye muri ico gisagara,

atwara n’abantu bo muri ico gisagara, abashingira ibikebere, bamwe baba abasatura imbaho, abandi bagakoresha amasipiri n’incabiti. Dawidi abigenza atyo mu bisagara vyose vy’Abamoni. Hanyuma Dawidi n’ingabo zose basubira i Yerusalemu.

Hanyuma y’ivyo, havyuka intambara hagati y’Abisirayeli n’Abafilisitiya, ibera ahitwa Gezeri. Muri ico gihe Sibekayi Umuhushati yica Sipayi, umwe mu bakomoka ku Barefayimu, kandi Abafilisitiya baraneshwa.
Mu yindi ntambara bagwana n’Abafilisitiya, Eluhanani mwene Yayiro yica Lahimi umuvukanyi wa Goliyati w’i Gati, uruti rw’icumu ryiwe rwangana n’umuhini.

Kandi mu yindi ntambara yabereye i Gati, hari umugabo munini cane yari afise intoke zitandatu ku kiganza cose n’amano atandatu ku kirenge cose; vyose hamwe vyari mirongo ibiri na bine. Na we nyene yakomoka kuri Rafa.
Atanguye gucokora Abisirayeli, Yonatani mwene Shimeya, yavukana na Dawidi, aramwica.
Abo bari abakomoka kuri Rafa w’i Gati, kandi bishwe na Dawidi n’abantu biwe.
Maze Satani ahagurukira Abisirayeli aca yosha umutima wa Dawidi ngo aharure Abisirayeli bose.
Nuko Dawidi abwira Yowabu n’intwazangabo ati: “Genda muharure Abisirayeli kuva i Berisheba gushika i Dani. Muce mumbwira kugira ngo menye igitigiri cabo.”

Ariko Yowabu amwishura ati: “ Uhoraho arakagwiza ingabo ziwe incuro ijana. Mwami wanje, mbega bose si abasavyi bawe? None ni iki gitumye umwami wanje akora atyo? Ni igiki cotuma uteza Abisirayeli kubonekako icaha?”
Ariko ijambo ry’umwami riremera Yowabu; maze Yowabu ava imbere yiwe aca akwiragira mu Bisirayeli bose aca agaruka i Yerusalemu.
Yowabu ashikiriza Dawidi igitigiri c’abantu baja ku rugamba. Muri Isirayeli hari umuliyoni umwe n’ijana b’ababahizi bazi kugwanisha inkota, mu Buyuda na ho ibihumbi amajana ane na mirongo indwi.
Ariko Yowabu ntiyashiramwo Abalewi n’Ababenyamini mu guharura, kuko atashaka gukora iryo tegeko ry’umwami.
Kandi iryo tegeko ntiryanezereje Imana; ivyo bituma ihana Abisirayeli.
Nuko Dawidi abwira Imana ati: “Nacumuye cane ku bw’ico kintu nakoze. None rero, ndakwinginze, unkureko icaha canje jewe umusavyi wawe. Nakoze ivy’ubupfu rwose.”
Uhoraho abwira Gadi, uwerekwa wa Dawidi ati:
“Genda ubwire Dawidi uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Ndaguhaye ibintu bitatu. Hitamwo kimwe nzoguhanisha.’ ”
Nuko Gadi aja kwa Dawidi aramubwira ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Hitamwo kimwe:

imyaka itatu y’inzara, amezi atatu uneshwa n’abansi aho inkota y’abansi banyu izobashikako, canke imisi itatu y’inkota y’ Uhoraho ; imisi y’ikiza mu gihugu, aho umumarayika w’ Uhoraho azokwica abantu mu bice vyose vya Isirayeli.’ None rero, hitamwo hanyuma umbwire ico nishura uwantumye.”
Dawidi abwira Gadi ati: “Ndi n’umubabaro mwinshi. Reka mpfume ngwa mu maboko y’ Uhoraho , kuko imbabazi ziwe ari nyinshi; ariko singwe mu maboko y’abantu.”
Nuko Uhoraho arungika ikiza mu Bisirayeli, abantu ibihumbi mirongo indwi vy’Abisirayeli barapfa.

Maze Imana ituma umumarayika ngo arandure Yerusalemu. Ariko igihe uwo mumarayika yariko arabikora, Uhoraho arabiraba ababazwa n’ico cago aca abwira uwo mumarayika yariko aratikiza abantu ati: “Geza aho! Garukana ukuboko kwawe.” Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho yari ahagaze ku mbuga yo kugosorerako ingano ya Orunani Umuyebusi.

Dawidi aravye hejuru abona wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho ahagaze hagati y’isi n’ijuru, afise inkota iri mu kuboko kwiwe ibanguye kuri Yerusalemu. Nuko Dawidi n’abakuru muri Isirayeli, baca bambara amagunira bubama hasi.

Dawidi abwira Imana ati: “Mbega si jewe nategetse ko baharura ingabo? Ni jewe nacumuye nkora ibidakwiye. Aba bo ni intama gusa. None bakoze iki? Yewe Uhoraho Mana yanje, ukuboko kwawe niguhane jewe n’umuryango wanje, ariko iki kiza ntikigume mu bantu bawe.”
Maze umumarayika w’ Uhoraho ategeka Gadi kubwira Dawidi ngo aduge yubakire Uhoraho igicaniro ku mbuga yo kugosorerako ingano ya Orunani Umuyebusi.
Nuko Dawidi araduga yubashe iryo jambo Gadi yamubwiye mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho .
Mu gihe Orunani yariko aragosora ingano, ahindukiye abona wa mumarayika; maze abahungu biwe bane bari kumwe na we biruka kwinyegeza.
Maze Dawidi arashika, Orunani yunamuye amaso aramubona, aca ava kuri ya mbuga yo kugosorerako yunama imbere ya Dawidi, ashika hasi.
Dawidi aramubwira ati: “Numpe iki kibanza c’imbuga yawe kugira ngo ndahubakire Uhoraho igicaniro, maze ikiza kiri mu bantu gihagarare. Ndahakugurira ku giciro bikwiranye.”

Orunani abwira Dawidi ati: “Hashikire! Umwami wanje nahakoreshe ico ashaka cose. Ehe, ndatanga n’impfizi z’ikimazi co guturirwa n’umuriro, imihini yo gusekura ingano ndayitanze ngo ibe inkwi, n’ingano na zo ngo zibe ishikanwa ry’ifu. Ivyo vyose ndabiguhaye.”

Ariko umwami Dawidi yishura Orunani ati: “Oya, ndakwinginze unyemerere ndakurihe igiciro bikwiranye. Sinshobora gushikanira Uhoraho ibintu vyawe, canke ngo nshikane ikimazi co guturirwa ata co ndakiguze.”
Nuko Dawidi ariha Orunani shekeli amajana atandatu vy’inzahabu ku bw’ico kibanza.

Dawidi yubakira Uhoraho igicaniro aho nyene aca ashikana ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’ivy’ishimwe. Yambaza Uhoraho , maze Uhoraho na we aramwishura, amanura umuriro uvuye mw’ijuru uza kuri ca gicaniro c’ibimazi vyo guturirwa.
Nuko Uhoraho avugana na wa mumarayika, asubiza inkota yiwe mu rwubati.
Muri ico gihe, Dawidi abonye ko Uhoraho yishuye isengesho ryiwe kuri ya mbuga yo kugosorerako ingano ya Orunani Umuyebusi, aca atangiraho ibimazi.
Ihema ry’ Uhoraho , iryo Mose yari yarubatse mu bugaragwa, n’igicaniro co guturirirako ibimazi vyari mw’itaba ry’umusozi i Gibeyoni.
Ariko Dawidi ntiyashoboye kujayo ngo asiguze Imana, kuko yari yatekewe n’ubwoba igihe yabona ya nkota y’umumarayika w’ Uhoraho .
Maze Dawidi aca avuga ati: “Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Imana izoba aha nyene, n’igicaniro co guturirirako ibimazi vy’Abisirayeli ni uko nyene.”
Maze Dawidi atanga amategeko ko bakoranya abantu b’abanyamahanga baba mu Bisirayeli, atoranya muri bo abo kubaza amabuye ngo bategure amabuye abajwe yo kuzokwubaka Ingoro y’Imana.
Ategura ubutare bw’ivyuma vyo gukoramwo imisumari y’imyango y’amarembo n’iyo kumanikako ibintu, n’ubutare bw’ivyuma bwinshi budashobora gupimwa uburemere.
Ategura n’ibiti vy’amasederi vyinshi bitoharurika, kuko Abanyesidoni n’Abatiro bari babizaniye Dawidi ari vyinshi cane.

Dawidi avuga ati: “Umuhungu wanje Salomo aracari muto kandi nta burambe afise mu bikorwa, kandi Ingoro yo kwubakira Uhoraho ikwiye kuba ari akaroruhore kandi ari rurangiranwa imbere y’amahanga yose. Nkwiye rero gutegura ivyo kuzokwubakisha.” Nuko Dawidi agira imyiteguro myinshi imbere y’uko apfa.
Maze ahamagara umuhungu wiwe Salomo amushinga kuzokwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Dawidi abwira Salomo ati: “Mwana wanje, nari narabigabiye mu mutima wanje ko nzokwubaka Ingoro yo guhesha icubahiro Izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yanje.

Ariko Uhoraho ambwira iri jambo ati: ‘Wavishije amaraso menshi kandi wagwanye intambara nyinshi. Ntiwoshobora kwubaka Ingoro yitirirwa izina ryanje, kuko wavishije amaraso menshi kw’isi mu nyonga zanje.
Ariko uzoronka umuhungu azoba umuntu w’amahoro n’itekane, kandi nzomuha kuruhuka abansi biwe mu mpande zose. Izina ryiwe azokwitwa Salomo, kandi nzoha Isirayeli amahoro n’umutekano ku ngoma yiwe.
Uwo ni we azokwubaka Ingoro yitirirwa izina ryanje. Azombera umuhungu, nanje ndamubere se. Kandi nzokomeza ingoma y’ubwami bwiwe mu Bisirayeli ibihe bidashira.’
None rero mwana wanje, Uhoraho abane nawe, kugira ngo ushobore kwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Imana yawe, nk’uko yavuze ko uzobikora.
Uhoraho aze aguhe kuroranya n’ugutahura niyagushira ku ntebe y’inganji y’Abisirayeli, kugira ngo uze witondere Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho Imana yawe.
