Nuko uzotera imbere niwitondera ivyo yashinze n’ivyagezwe vyose Uhoraho yahaye Mose ngo abihe Abisirayeli. Ukomere kandi ushire ubwoba. Ntutinye canke ngo ucike intege.

Narakoze ndaruha kugira ngo ntegure ibikoresho vyose bikenewe vy’iyo Ngoro y’ Uhoraho . Negeranije italanto ibihumbi ijana z’inzahabu, italanto umuliyoni umwe z’ifeza, ubutare bwinshi bw’umwakaka n’ivyuma vyinshi bitoharurika, n’ibiti n’amabuye. Kandi ushobora kwongerako n’ibindi.
Ufise abakozi benshi: ababaza amabuye, abubakisha amabuye n’abubakisha ibiti n’imbaho, n’abahinga mu gikorwa ico ari co cose
mu nzahabu no mw’ifeza, umwakaka n’ivyuma; abacuzi barenze igitigiri. Nuko shirako wubake, kandi Uhoraho ari kumwe nawe.”
Maze Dawidi ategeka abatwara abandi mu Bisirayeli gufasha umuhungu wiwe Salomo.

Arababwira ati: “Mbega Uhoraho Imana yanyu ntari kumwe namwe? Ntiyanabemereye kubaha impore impande zose? Kuko yampaye abantu bose baba muri iki gihugu, kandi iki gihugu cose kiri mu minwe y’ Uhoraho n’abantu biwe.

Nuko rero mushire imitima yanyu n’imishaha yanyu k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu. Mushireko mwubake Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Imana, kugira ngo muzane Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho n’ibikoresho vyera vy’Imana muri iyo Ngoro izokwubakirwa Izina ry’ Uhoraho .”

headings.text: Dawidi ategura ivyo kwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho

verses.text: Igihe Dawidi yari ashaje ageze mu zabukuru, yaciye yimika umuhungu wiwe Salomo ngo abe umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Akoranya abakuru barongoye abandi mu Bisirayeli, hamwe n’abaherezi n’Abalewi.
Abalewi bafise imyaka mirongo itatu n’iyirenga baraharurwa, maze igitigiri cabo bose gishika ku bantu ibihumbi mirongo itatu n’umunani.
Dawidi avuga ati: “Muri aba, ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine baze barongore abandi mu bikorwa vyo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , abandi ibihumbi bitandatu na bo baze babe abakuru n’abacamanza.
Ibihumbi bine baze bazezwe kurinda irembo maze ibindi bihumbi bine baze babe abo guhimbaza Uhoraho n’ibicurarangisho nateguye ku bw’ico gikorwa.”
Dawidi aca agabura Abalewi mu migwi nk’uko bene Lewi bari bari: Gerishoni, Kohati na Merari.
Abo mu Bagerishoni bari: Ladani na Shimeyi.
Bene Ladani ni: umukuru wabo Yehiyeli, Zetamu na Yoweli, bose hamwe bari batatu.
Bene Shimeyi ni: Shelomoti, Haziyeli na Harani, bose hamwe bari batatu. Abo ni bo bari abakuru b’inzu mu muryango wa Ladani.
Kandi bene Shimeyi bari: Yahati, Ziza, Yewushi na Beriya. Abo ni bo bari bene Shimeyi, bose bari bane.
Yahati yari imfura Ziza akaba uwa kabiri, ariko Yewushi na Beriya ntibavyaye abahungu benshi; ni co gituma baharuwe nk’umuryango umwe bahabwa n’igikorwa kimwe.
Bene Kohati ni: Amuramu, Izihari, Heburoni na Uziyeli, bose bari bane.

Bene Amuramu ni: Aroni na Mose. Aroni aratoranywa, we n’uruvyaro rwiwe ibihe bidashira, ngo bazezwe ibintu vyose vyejejwe, bashikane ibimazi imbere y’ Uhoraho , bakorere imbere yiwe bongere bahezagire abantu mw’izina ryiwe ibihe bidashira.
Bene Mose umuntu w’Imana baharuwe nk’abo mu muryango wa Lewi.
Bene Mose ni: Gerishomu na Eliyezeri.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Gerishomu: umukuru wabo yari Shubayeli.
Abakomoka kuri Eliyezeri: umukuru wabo yari Rehabiya. Eliyezeri nta bahungu yari afise, ariko bene Rehabiya bari benshi.
Bene Izihari: umukuru wabo yari Shelomiti.
Bene Heburoni: umukuru yari Yeriya, uwa kabiri akaba Amariya, uwa gatatu akaba Yahaziyeli, uwa kane akaba Yekameyamu.
Bene Uziyeli: umukuru wabo yari Mika, Isihiya akaba uwa kabiri.
Bene Merari: Mahuli na Mushi. Bene Mahuli: Eliyazeri na Kishi.
Eliyazeri yapfuye ata bahungu avyaye: yari afise abakobwa gusa. Bene sewabo, bene Kishi, ni bo babarongoye.
Bene Mushi: Mahuli, Ederi na Yeremoti, bose bari batatu.

Abo ni bo bakomoka kuri Lewi nk’uko amazu yabo yari ari: abakuru b’amazu bari banditswe hakurikijwe urutonde rw’amazina yabo. Umuntu wese yaharuwe yaba amaze imyaka mirongo ibiri canke irenga kugira ngo akore mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Kuko Dawidi yari yaravuze ati: “Ko Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, yemeye guha impore abantu biwe kandi ko yaje akaba i Yerusalemu ibihe vyose,
Abalewi ntibagikeneye kurerura ihema canke ibikoresho na bimwe bikoreshwa muri ryo.”
Nk’uko vyari vyarashinzwe na Dawidi mu misi yiwe ya nyuma, Abalewi bari baharuwe kuva ku bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga.

Ico Abalewi bari bashinzwe kwari ugufasha bene Aroni mu bikorwa vyo mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho : ibikorwa vyo mu rugo, ivyo mu vyumba, guhumanura ivyera vyose no gutunganya ibindi bikorwa vyo mu Ngoro y’Imana.
Bari bashinzwe ya mikate yategerezwa kwama ishirwa ku meza, ifu y’indobanurwa itangwako amashikanwa y’ifu, imitsima itarimwo umwambiro, gukaranga no kuvanga, hamwe no gupima urugero rw’ikintu cose.
Bategerezwa guhagarara uko bukeye bashimira Uhoraho bamuhimbaza no ku mugoroba bagakora uko nyene,

n’igihe cose abantu baje gushikanira Uhoraho ibimazi vyo guturirwa ku masabato no ku misi mikuru y’ukwezi gutashe hamwe no ku misi mikuru yashinzwe. Bategerezwa gukorera imbere y’ Uhoraho ubudasiba hakurikijwe igitigiri c’abakenewe muri bo kandi nk’uko bari bategetswe kubikora.
Uko ni ko Abalewi bakora ivyo bashinzwe gukora mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, ivyerekeye Ahera, barongowe n’ab’iwabo bo mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni, bagakora ivyo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Iyi ni yo mice y’uruvyaro rwa Aroni: Bene Aroni bari Nadabu, Abihu, Eliyazeri na Itamari.
Ariko Nadabu na Abihu batanze se gupfa, kandi nta bahungu basize. Nuko Eliyazeri na Itamari baciye bakora nk’abaherezi.
Dawidi abashira mu migwi yisunze ivyo bazokora n’urutonde bari bakwiye gukorerako, afashijwe na Sadoki akomoka kuri Eliyazeri na Ahimeleki akomoka kuri Itamari.

Abarongozi benshi bavuye mu ruvyaro rwa Eliyazeri kuruta abavuye mu rwa Itamari, maze bashirwa mu migwi bisunze ico nyene: abakuru b’amazu bava mu bakomoka kuri Eliyazeri bari cumi na batandatu, hanyuma abakuru b’amazu bava ku bakomoka kuri Itamari bari umunani.

Babagabuye mu migwi y’ibikorwa batarenganije n’umwe kuko bakoresheje ubupfindo. Ivyo vyatumwe n’uko hariho benshi bari babereye gukora mu Ingoro y’Imana bava mu bakomoka kuri Eliyazeri na Itamari bompi.

Umwanditsi Shemaya mwene Netaneli Umulewi, yanditse amazina yabo ari imbere y’umwami n’abakuru bose: Sadoki umuherezi, Ahimeleki mwene Abiyatari n’abakuru b’amazu y’abaherezi n’Abalewi, bagafata umwe wo mu nzu kwa Eliyazeri hanyuma uwundi wo mu nzu kwa Itamari.
Ubupfindo bwa mbere bwerekanye Yehoyaribu, ubwa kabiri bwerekanye Yedayiya,
ubwa gatatu bwerekanye Harimu, ubwa kane bwerekanye Seyorimu,
ubwa gatanu bwerekanye Malikiya, ubwa gatandatu bwerekanye Miyamini,
ubw’indwi bwerekanye Hakozi, ubw’umunani bwerekanye Abiya,
ubw’icenda bwerekanye Yesuwa, ubw’icumi bwerekanye Shekaniya,
ubw’icumi na rimwe bwerekanye Eliyashibu, ubw’icumi na kabiri bwerekanye Yakimu,
Ubw’icumi na gatatu bwerekanye Hupa, ubw’icumi na kane bwerekanye Yeshebeyabu,
ubw’icumi na gatanu bwerekanye Biluga, ubw’icumi na gatandatu bwerekanye Imeri,
ubw’icumi n’indwi bwerekanye Heziri, ubw’icumi n’umunani bwerekanye Hapizezi,
ubw’icumi n’icenda bwerekanye Petahiya, ubwa mirongo ibiri bwerekanye Yehezikeli,
ubwa mirongo ibiri na rimwe bwerekanye Yakini, ubwa mirongo ibiri na kabiri bwerekanye Gamuli,
ubwa mirongo ibiri na gatatu bwerekanye Delaya, ubwa mirongo ibiri na kane bwerekanye Mayaziya.

Urwo ni rwo rutonde bakurikiza mu gukora igikorwa c’Imana iyo baramukiwe kwinjira mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho , bisunze amategeko yabagenga yashizweho na sekuru wabo Aroni kandi nk’uko Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, yari yaramutegetse.
Aba ni bo bandi bakuru b’imiryango yakomoka kuri Lewi: Mu bakomoka kuri Amuramu: umukuru wabo yari Shubayeli; mu bakomoka kuri Shubayeli: umukuru wabo yari Yehudeya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Rehabiya, abavuye ku bahungu biwe: umukuru wabo yari Isihiya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Izihari: umukuru wabo yari Shelomoti; mu bakomoka kuri Shelomoti: umukuru wabo yari Yahati.
Mu bakomoka kuri Heburoni: Yeriya ni we yari mukuru, uwa kabiri ni Amariya, uwa gatatu ni Yahaziyeli, uwa kane na we ni Yekamiyami.
Mu bakomoka kuri Uziyeli: umukuru wabo yari Mika; mu bakomoka kuri Mika: umukuru wabo yari Shamiri.
Umuvukanyi wa Mika: yari Isihiya. Mu bamukomokako, Zakariya ni we yari mukuru.
Mu bakomoka kuri Merari: abakuru babo bari Mahuli na Mushi. Mu bakomoka kuri Yayaziya: umukuru wabo yari Beno.
Mu bakomoka kuri Merari: Kuva kuri Yayaziya: abakuru babo bari Beno, Shohamu, Zakuri na Iburi.
Mu bakomoka kuri Mahuli: umukuru wabo yari Eliyazeri, naho atigeze aronka abahungu.
Mu bakomoka kuri Kishi: umukuru wabo yari Yerahimeyeli.
Ku bakomoka kuri Mushi: abakuru babo bari Mahuli, Ederi na Yerimoti. Abo bari Abalewi, nk’uko imiryango yabo yari iri.

Na ho nyene barakoresheje ubupfindo, nk’uko benewabo bakomoka kuri Aroni babikoze, imbere y’umwami Dawidi na Sadoki, Ahimeleki, n’abakuru b’amazu y’abaherezi n’Abalewi. Inzu zikomoka ku muvukanyi mukuru zafatwa co kimwe n’inzu zikomoka kuri mutoya muri bo.

Dawidi, ari kumwe n’abakuru b’ingabo, atoranya bamwe muri bene Asafu, Hemani na Yedutuni ngo bakore igikorwa co kuvuga amajambo avuye ku Mana, bavugira inanga, amakembe n’ivyuma bisama. Uru ni rwo rutonde rw’abakora ico gikorwa:
Mu bahungu ba Asafu hari: Zakuri, Yosefu, Netaniya na Asarela. Bene Asafu bari barongowe na se Asafu, yavuga amajambo avuye ku Mana akurikije amategeko y’umwami.

Mu bahungu ba Yedutuni, hari: Gedaliya, Zeri, Yeshaya, Shimeyi, Hashabiya na Matitiya, bose hamwe bari batandatu, barongowe na se Yedutuni, yavuga amajambo y’Imana, avuza inanga mu gushimira no mu guhimbaza Uhoraho .
Mu bahungu ba Hemani hari: Bukiya, Mataniya, Uziyeli, Shubayeli na Yerimoti; Hananiya, Hanani, Eliyata, Gidaliti na Romamuti-Ezeri; Yoshibekasha, Maloti, Hotiri na Mahaziyoti.
Abo bose bari bene Hemani uwerekwa w’umwami. Imana yari yabamuhaye biciye mw’isezerano ngo imushire hejuru. Imana imuha abahungu icumi na bane n’abakobwa batatu.

Abo bose bari barongowe na ba se babo mu kuririmba no mu gucuraranga mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho , bakoresheje ivyuma bisama, amakembe n’inanga, ku bw’ico gikorwa co mu Ngoro y’Imana. Asafu, Yedutuni na Hemani bari musi y’uburongozi bw’umwami.
Abo bari kumwe n’abo mu nzu zabo, bose bari barigishijwe bongera bamenyerezwa ivyerekeye kuririmbira Uhoraho , bashika amajana abiri na mirongo umunani n’umunani.
Abacuraranga bose bashirwa ku bikorwa vyabo hakoreshejwe ubupfindo, ntibaraba ngo umuntu aracari muto canke arakuze, ni umwigisha canke ni umwigishwa.

Ubupfindo bwa mbere bwerekanye Yosefu wo mu nzu kwa Asafu, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri. Ubupfindo bwa kabiri bwerekana Gedaliya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa gatatu bwerekana Zakuri, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa kane bwerekana Iziri, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa gatanu bwerekana Netaniya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa gatandatu bwerekana Bukiya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bw’indwi bwerekana Yesarela, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bw’umunani bwerekana Yeshaya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bw’icenda bwerekana Mataniya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bw’icumi bwerekana Shimeyi, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi na rimwe bwerekana Azareli, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi na kabiri bwerekana Hashabiya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi na gatatu bwerekana Shubayeli, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi na kane bwerekana Matitiya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi na gatanu bwerekana Yeremoti, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi na gatandatu bwerekana Hananiya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi n’indwi bwerekana Yoshibekasha, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi n’umunani bwerekana Hanani, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi n’icenda bwerekana Maloti, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa mirongo ibiri bwerekana Eliyata, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa mirongo ibiri na rimwe bwerekana Hotiri, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa mirongo ibiri na kabiri bwerekana Gidaliti, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa mirongo ibiri na gatatu bwerekana Mahaziyoti, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa mirongo ibiri na kane bwerekana Romamuti-Ezeri, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Imigwi y’abarinzi b’irembo: Mu bakomoka kuri Kora hari Meshelemiya umuhungu wa Kore, umwe muri bene Abiyasafu.
Abahungu ba Meshelemiya bari: Zakariya imfura, Yediyayeli uwa kabiri, Zebadiya uwa gatatu, Yatuniyeli uwa kane,
Elamu uwa gatanu, Yehohanani uwa gatandatu na Eliyehowenayi uw’indwi.
Abahungu ba Obedi-Edomu na bo nyene bari abarinzi b’irembo: Shemaya imfura, Yehozabadi uwa kabiri, Yowa uwa gatatu, Sakari uwa kane, Netaneli uwa gatanu,
Amiyeli uwa gatandatu, Isakari uw’indwi na Pewuletayi uw’umunani. Imana yari yarahaye umugisha mwinshi Obedi-Edomu.
Shemaya mwene Obedi-Edomu na we nyene yari afise abahungu, bari abakuru mu mazu y’abakomoka kuri se kuko bari abantu babishoboye.
Bene Shemaya bari: Otini, Refayeli, Obedi na Elizabadi; hamwe na benewabo Elihu na Semakiya na bo nyene bari abantu babishoboye.

Abo bose bari abakomoka kuri Obedi-Edomu; bo ubwabo, abahungu babo n’abuzukuru babo, bari abantu bashoboye b’inkomezi zo gukora ico gikorwa; bose hamwe abakomoka kuri Obedi-Edomu, bari mirongo itandatu na babiri.
Abahungu ba Meshelemiya n’abo mu nzu yiwe bose babakomokako, bari bashoboye, bose hamwe bari cumi n’umunani.
Hosa akomoka mu nzu kwa Merari yari afise abahungu: Umukuru wabo yari Shimuri naho atari we yari imfura, se wiwe yari yamutoye ngo abe uwa mbere,
Hilukiya uwa kabiri, Tabaliya uwa gatatu na Zakariya uwa kane. Abahungu ba Hosa n’abo mu nzu yiwe bose babakomokako bakora igikorwa co kurinda irembo bari icumi na batatu.
Iyo migwi y’abarinzi b’irembo, biciye mu bakuru babo, bari bafise ibikorwa vyo gukorera mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho , nk’uko benewabo bandi b’Abalewi babikora.
Abakora kw’irembo ryose batorwa hakoreshejwe ubupfindo, bataravye umuto canke umukuru, bakurikiza inzu zabo gusa.

Ubupfindo bw’abarinda Irembo ryo mu Buseruko bwerekanye Shelemiya n’abo bari kumwe. Maze bakora ubundi bupfindo bwerekana umuhungu wiwe Zakariya azezwa irembo ryo mu buraruko, yari umujenama w’umunyabwenge.
Ubupfindo bw’abarinda Irembo ryo mu Bumanuko bwerekana Obedi-Edomu, kandi ubupfindo bwo kwerakana abarinda inzu y’ububiko bwerekana abahungu biwe.
Ubufindo bw’abarinda Irembo ryo mu Burengero no kw’Irembo rya Shaleketi ku nzira iduga bwerekana Shupimu na Hosa. Abarinzi bagenwa hakurikijwe ingene aho bakorera hahambaye:
Hari Abalewi batandatu ku musi kw’Irembo ryo mu Buseruko, bane ku musi kw’Irembo ryo mu Buraruko, bane ku musi kw’Irembo ryo mu Bumanuko na babiribabiri bakorera rimwe ku nzu y’ububiko.
Kw’Irembo ryo mu Burengero hari abarinzi babiri n’abandi bane barinda inzira yaca inyuma y’urugo.
Iyo yari imigwi y’abarinzi b’irembo bakomoka ku mazu ya Kora na Merari.
Uwundi mugwi w’Abalewi, urongowe na Ahiya, wari uw’abanyabigega b’ubutunzi bwo mu Ngoro y’Imana n’ubutunzi bw’ibintu vyeguriwe Imana.
Abakomoka kuri Ladani, wo mu nzu kwa Gerishoni bari abakuru b’amazu kandi umukuru wabo yari Yehiyeli,
abahungu ba Yehiyeli ari bo Zetamu n’uwo bavukana Yoweli, bari bajejwe ubutunzi bwo mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Aba ni bo bari abakuru mu mazu y’abakomoka kuri Amuramu, Izihari, Heburoni na Uziyeli:
Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Amuramu, Shubayeli akomoka kuri Gerishomu mwene Mose, yari umukuru ajejwe ubutunzi.
Abo mu muryango wiwe uciye kuri Eliyezeri bari: Rehabiya, Yeshaya, Yoramu, Zikuri na Shelomoti.

Shelomoti n’abo mu muryango wiwe bari bajejwe ubutunzi bwose bw’ibintu umwami Dawidi, abakuru b’imiryango batwara ingabo igihumbi n’abatwara ingabo ijana, n’abandi bakuru b’ingabo bari bareguriye Imana.
Bimwe mu vyanyazwe mu gihe c’intambara vyari vyeguriwe gusanura ingoro y’ Uhoraho .
N’ibintu vyose Samweli uwerekwa, Sawuli mwene Kishi, Abuneri mwene Neri, Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya, n’abandi bose bari bareguriye Imana vyari bijejwe Shelomoti n’abo mu nzu yiwe.
Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Izihari: Kenaniya n’abahungu biwe bari bashinzwe ibikorwa bitajanye n’Ingoro, bari abakuru bajejwe ubucamanza mu Bisirayeli.

Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Heburoni: Hashabiya we n’abo mu muryango wiwe; abagabo igihumbi n’amajana indwi bashoboye, bari bajejwe Abisirayeli baba mu burengero bwa Yorodani, mu gikorwa cose c’ Uhoraho n’igikorwa cose kiraba uwami muri ako karere.

Kandi mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Heburoni na bo, hari Yeriya akaba umukuru wabo nk’uko vyanditswe mu bitabu bidondagura ingene bagiye bararondoka. Mu mwaka ugira mirongo ine Dawidi ari ku ngoma, harabaye kurondera mu vyanditswe, basanga harimwo abagabo bashoboye mu bakomoka kuri Heburoni b’i Yazeri i Gileyadi.

Yeriya yari afise abantu ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana indwi, bari abagabo bashoboye bakaba abakuru b’inzu zigize umuryango, kandi umwami Dawidi abazeza Abareyubeni, Abagadi n’igice c’Abamanase mu kintu cose cerekeye Imana n’icerekeye umwami mu buseruko bwa Yorodani.

Uru ni rwo rutonde rw’Abisirayeli, bari abakuru b’amazu, abakuru b’ingabo igihumbi, abakuru b’ingabo ijana, n’abakuru batwara abandi, bakorera umwami mu bijanye n’imice y’ingabo baramukirwa gukora uko ukwezi gutashe mu mwaka wose. Umuce wose waba ugizwe n’ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Yashobeyamu mwene Zabudiyeli ni we yari ajejwe umuce wa mbere, wari ujejwe gukora mu kwezi kwa mbere. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Yari uwo mu ruvyaro rwa Perezi kandi yari umukuru yatwara abakuru mu ngabo bajejwe gukora mu kwezi kwa mbere.
Dodayi Umwahohi ni we yari ajejwe umuce wo mu kwezi kwa kabiri; Mikiloti ni we yari umukuru w’uwo muce. Uwo muce wari ugizwe n’ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira gatatu, yari ajejwe ukwezi kwa gatatu, yari Benaya mwene Yehoyada umuherezi. Yari umukuru kandi umuce wiwe warimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Uwo Benaya ni we yari umuhizi muri bamwe mirongo itatu kandi ni we yari umukuru wabo. Umuhungu wiwe Amizabadi yari ajejwe uwo muce wa se.

Umukuru w’ingabo agira kane, yari ajejwe gukora mu kwezi kwa kane, yari Asaheli yavukana na Yowabu; umuhungu wiwe Zebadiya ni we yamusubiriye. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira gatanu, yari ajejwe ukwezi kwa gatanu, yari Shamuhuti Umwizirahi. Umuce wiwe warimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira gatandatu, yari ajejwe ukwezi kwa gatandatu, yari Ira mwene Ikeshi w’i Tekowa. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira indwi, yari ajejwe ukwezi kw’indwi, yari Helezi Umupeloni, Umwefurayimu. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira umunani, yari ajejwe ukwezi kw’umunani, yari Sibekayi Umuhushati w’Umuzera. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira icenda, yari ajejwe ukwezi kw’icenda, yari Abiyezeri Umwanatoti, w’Umubenyamini. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira icumi, yari ajejwe ukwezi kw’icumi, yari Maharayi Umunetofati, w’Umuzera. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira icumi na rimwe, yari ajejwe ukwezi kw’icumi na rimwe, yari Benaya Umupiratoni, w’Umwefurayimu. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira icumi na kabiri, yari ajejwe ukwezi kw’icumi na kabiri, yari Heludayi Umunetofati, wo mu muryango wa Otiniyeli. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Abari abakuru b’imiryango y’Abisirayeli ni aba: Mu bakomoka kuri Reyubeni: Eliyezeri mwene Zikuri; mu bakomoka kuri Simeyoni: Shefatiya mwene Mayaka;
mu bakomoka kuri Lewi: Hashabiya mwene Kemuweli; mu bakomoka kuri Aroni: Sadoki;
mu bakomoka kuri Yuda: Elihu, yavukana na Dawidi; mu bakomoka kuri Isakari: Omuri mwene Mikayeli;
mu bakomoka kuri Zebuloni: Ishimaya mwene Obadiya; mu bakomoka kuri Nafutali: Yerimoti mwene Aziriyeli;
mu bakomoka kuri Efurayimu: Hoseya mwene Azaziya; mu bakomoka ku gice c’umuryango wa Manase: Yoweli mwene Pedaya;
mu bakomoka ku gice c’umuryango wa Manase kindi c’i Gileyadi: Ido mwene Zakariya; mu bakomoka kuri Benyamini: Yayasiyeli mwene Abuneri;
mu bakomoka kuri Dani: Azareli mwene Yerohamu. Abo ni bo bari abakuru batwara imiryango y’Abisirayeli.
Igihe Dawidi yaharura abantu ntiyaharuyemwo abafise imyaka mirongo ibiri canke batarayishikana, kuko Uhoraho yari yarasezeranye ko azogwiza Abisirayeli ngo bangane n’inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru.
Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya atangura guharura abantu ariko ntiyaheza. Uburake buziriringira Abisirayeli kubera ukwo guharurwa, maze ico gitigiri nticandikwa mu gitabu c’ibigenda biraba c’umwami Dawidi.
Azimaveti mwene Adiyeli yari ajejwe amazu y’ububiko bw’umwami. Yonatani mwene Uziya yari ajejwe amazu y’ububiko yari mu ntara, mu bisagara, mu bigwati no ku minara yo gucungererako.
Ezuri mwene Kelubi yari ajejwe abakozi bo mu mirima barima mu matongo.
Shimeyi w’i Ramati yari ajejwe imirima y’imizabibu. Zabudi w’i Shifumi yari ajejwe umwimbu w’imizabibu n’ububiko bw’umuvinyu.
Bayali-Hanani w’i Gederi yari ajejwe imyelayo n’imisukomora mu gice c’uburengero. Yowashi yari ajejwe ububiko bw’amavuta ya elayo.
Shiturayi w’i Sharoni yari ajejwe inka zarisha i Sharoni. Shafati mwene Adulayi yari ajejwe amasho yo mu biyaya.
Obili Umwishimayeli yari ajejwe ingamiya. Yehudeya w’i Meronoti yari ajejwe indogoba.
Yazizi Umuhaguri yari ajejwe imikuku y’impene n’intama. Abo bose bari abakuru bajejwe ubutunzi bw’umwami Dawidi.
Yonatani, sewabo wa Dawidi, yari umuhanuzi, umugabo w’ubwenge akaba n’umwanditsi. Yehiyeli mwene Hakumoni yari ajejwe abahungu b’umwami.
Ahitofeli yari umuhanuzi w’umwami. Hushayi umwaruki yari umugenzi w’umwami.
Ahitofeli yasubiriwe na Yehoyada mwene Benaya na Abiyatari. Yowabu yari umukuru w’ingabo z’umwami.

Dawidi ahamagaza abakuru bose bo mu Bisirayeli ngo bakoranire i Yerusalemu: Abakuru b’imiryango, abakuru barongora ingabo igihumbi n’abakuru barongora ingabo ijana, n’abakuru bajejwe itunga n’ibitungwa vy’umwami n’abahungu biwe, n’abakuru bakorera ku kirimba, abahambaye bose n’abahizi bo mu ntambara.

Umwami Dawidi arahaguruka avuga ati: “Nimunyumvirize, bavukanyi mukaba n’abantu banje. Nari nariyumviriye mu mutima kwubaka inzu Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho izoruhukiramwo, indava y’ibirenge vy’Imana yacu, kandi naragize integuro yo kuyubaka.
Ariko Imana irambwira iti: ‘Ntushobora kwubaka inzu yitirirwa izina ryanje, kuko wagwanye intambara nyinshi kandi ukavisha amaraso menshi.’

Ariko Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, yantoranije mu muryango wanje wose ngo mbe umwami w’Abisirayeli ibihe bidashira. Yatoranije Yuda nk’umukuru, maze mu muryango wa Yuda itoranya inzu yanje, kandi no mu bahungu ba data yahimbawe no kunyimika ngo mbe umwami w’Abisirayeli bose.
Mu bahungu banje bose Uhoraho yampaye, kandi ni benshi, yatoranije umuhungu wanje Salomo ngo yicare ku ntebe y’ubwami bw’ Uhoraho aganze Abisirayeli.
Yambwiye ati: Salomo umuhungu wawe ni we azonyubakira Ingoro aho nzovyagira, kuko ndamutoranije ngo ambere umuhungu, nanje ndamubere se.
Nzokomeza ubwami bwiwe ibihe vyose niyashira umutima ku kwumvira amateka n’ivyo nashinze, nk’uko bikorwa ubu.

None rero ndabibasabiye imbere y’Abisirayeli bose n’ikoraniro ryose ry’ Uhoraho , n’imbere y’Imana yacu ivyumva: muze mwitwararike kwumvira amabwirizwa y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kugira ngo muze mugumane iki gihugu ciza kandi ngo muze mukirage uruvyaro rwanyu ibihe bidashira.

Nawe, Salomo mwana wanje, menya Imana ya so, uyikorere n’umutima wawe wose kandi ubikunze, kuko Uhoraho asesa umutima wose kandi azi ivyo umuntu yiyumvira akagabira. Niwamurondera, uzomubona; ariko niwamutera ibitugu, na we azoguta ibihe vyose.
Menya rero ibi, Uhoraho yaragutoranije ngo wubake Ingoro yiwe yera. Shikama ukore ico gikorwa.”
Nuko Dawidi aha umuhungu wiwe Salomo ya nteguro y’intangaro y’Ingoro, inyubako yayo, amazu y’ububiko bwayo, ibice vyo hejuru vyayo, ivyumba vy’imbere n’ikibanza co gutangiramwo impongano.

Amuha izo nteguro nk’uko Mpwemu yari yazishize mu bwenge bwiwe, harimwo izerekeye urugo rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , ivyumba birukikije, ivyumba vy’ububiko bw’Ingoro y’Imana n’ivyumba vy’ububiko bw’ivyagizwe inyegu.
Amubwira ivyo akwiye kwitondera vyerekeye imice y’abaherezi n’Abalewi, n’igikorwa cose co gukora mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , n’ivyerekeye ibikoresho vyose bikoreshwa muri iyo Ngoro.
Ashinga n’uburemere bw’inzahabu buzokora ku bikoresho vyose vy’inzahabu bizokora mu bikorwa bitandukanye, n’uburemere bw’ifeza buzokora ku bikoresho vyose vy’ifeza bizokora mu bikorwa bitandukanye:

Uburemere bw’inzahabu zo mu biterekwako amatara no mu matara yavyo, uburemere bw’igiterekwako amatara kimwekimwe cose n’amatara yaco, n’uburemere bw’ifeza z’igiterekwako amatara c’ifeza kimwekimwe cose n’amatara yaco, bijanye n’ico igiterekwako amatara cose kizokora;
uburemere bw’inzahabu bw’imeza yose y’imikate yejejwe; n’uburemere z’ifeza z’imeza zindi;

uburemere bw’inzahabu ihinguwe neza y’ivyaruzo vy’amenyo, amabakure yo gusukira n’ibindi bikoresho bikozwe mu nzahabu ihinguwe neza; uburemere bw’inzahabu yokoreshwa kw’isahani y’inzahabu imw’imwe yose; uburemere bw’ifeza kw’isahani y’ifeza imw’imwe yose;

n’uburemere bw’inzahabu ihinguwe neza y’igicaniro baturirirako ibimota neza. Yarongeye amuha ishusho y’umukogote, ni ukuvuga abakerubi bacuzwe mu nzahabu bashanje amababa yabo bakayapfukisha ya Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho .
Dawidi aravuga ati: “Ivyo vyose biri mu gitabu naronse kivuye k’ Uhoraho , ampa no gutahura ivyo vyose bikwiye gukorwa nk’uko biri muri iyi nteguro.”

Dawidi arongera abwira Salomo umwana wiwe ati: “Shikama ushire amanga, ukore ico gikorwa. Ntutinye canke ngo wihebure, kuko Uhoraho Imana, ari yo Mana yanje, iri kumwe nawe. Ntizoguta kandi ntizoguhemukira gushika aho igikorwa co kwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho kizoherera.

Imice y’abaherezi n’Abalewi bariteguye gukora igikorwa co mu Ngoro y’Imana, n’umuntu wese avyishakiye afise ubuhinga mu kintu ico ari co cose azogufasha muri iki gikorwa. Abakuru n’abantu bose bazokwumvira mu co uzobategeka cose.”

headings.text: Dawidi abwira abantu uko bazokwubaka ingoro y’ Uhoraho

verses.text: Hanyuma umwami Dawidi abwira ikoraniro ryose ati: “Umuhungu wanje Salomo, ari we Imana yatoranije, aracari muto kandi ntabimenyereye cane. Igikorwa ni kinini, kandi iyi Ngoro si iy’umuntu ahubwo ni iy’ Uhoraho Imana.

Nakoresheje inkomezi zanje zose mu gutegura ivyo kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana yanje: inzahabu zizokora ibikorwa vy’inzahabu, ifeza zizokoreshwa mu gukora ibikorwa vy’ifeza, imyakaka izokoreshwa mu gukora ibikorwa vy’imyakaka, ivyuma bizokoreshwa mu gukora ibikorwa bisaba ivyuma, n’ibiti bizokoreshwa mu gukora ibikorwa bisaba ibiti, n’amabuye azokoreshwa mu gukora ibikorwa bisaba amabuye yitwa onigisi yo gukora mu materanirizo, amabuye akayangana y’amabara atandukanye, n’ubwoko butandukanye bw’amabuye y’igiciro kinini hamwe na marubule; vyose ni vyinshi cane.

I ruhande y’ivyo, kubera ukwitangira Ingoro y’Imana yanje, ntanze ubutunzi bwanje bw’inzahabu n’ifeza ngo bibe ivy’iyo Ngoro y’Imana yanje, ndavyongeye kuri vya bindi vyose nateguriye kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana yanje birenze ku vyo nategekanije kubera iyo Ngoro yera:
Italanto ibihumbi bitatu z’inzahabu zavuye muri Ofiru, n’iz’ifeza ibihumbi indwi zihinguwe neza, zo guhomesha ku mpome y’iyo nyubakwa,
ivyo gukoreshwa mu gikorwa c’ifeza n’inzahabu, hamwe n’ibikorwa vyose bikwiye gukorwa n’abahinga. None rero ni nde agomba kwitanga uwu musi kubera Uhoraho ?”
Maze abakuru b’imiryango igize Isirayeli, abakuru barongoye ingabo igihumbi n’abarongoye ingabo ijana, n’abakuru bashinzwe gukora i bwami batanga bavyishakiye.

Batanga ivyo gukoresha ku Ngoro y’Imana bingana n’italanto ibihumbi bitanu na dariki ibihumbi cumi vy’inzahabu, italanto ibihumbi cumi z’ifeza, italanto ibihumbi cumi n’umunani z’umwakaka n’italanto ibihumbi ijana z’ivyuma.
Umuntu wese yari afise amabuye y’igiciro arayazana ngo aje mu bubiko bw’iyo Ngoro y’ Uhoraho bwari bujejwe Yehiyeli Umugerishoni.
Abantu baranezerwa kuko abakuru babo bemeye gukora bavyishakiye, kuko bari bashikaniye Uhoraho ata gahato kandi n’umutima ubikunze. N’umwami Dawidi aranezerwa cane.
Dawidi ahimbaza Uhoraho imbere y’ikoraniro ryose, avuga ati: “Uhimbazwe, yewe Uhoraho , Imana ya sogokuru Isirayeli, uhereye ibihe vyose ugashitsa ibihe vyose.
Ubukuru n’ububasha ni ivyawe n’ubwiza n’icubahiro n’igitinyiro, kuko ibiri mw’ijuru no mw’isi vyose ari ivyawe. Ubwami ni ubwawe, yewe Uhoraho ; ushizwe hejuru nk’uganza vyose.
Ubutunzi n’iteka biva iwawe; uri uwuganza vyose. Mu ntoke zawe hari inkomezi n’ububasha vyo gushira hejuru no gukomeza uwo ishatse wese.
None rero, Mana yacu, turagukengurukiye, kandi duhimbaje izina ryawe ry’ubwiza.
Ariko jewe ndi iki, abantu banje bo ni iki, ngo dushobore gutanga tuvyishakiye nk’uku? Vyose biva iwawe, natwe twaguhaye ibiva mu kuboko kwawe gusa.
Turi inyambukira n’ingenzi mu nyonga zawe, nk’uko na ba sogokuru bacu bari bari. Imisi yacu kw’isi ni nk’igitutu, nta vyizigiro.
Yewe Uhoraho Mana yacu, ibi vyose twatanze ngo bize vyubake Ingoro izokwitirirwa Izina ryawe Ryera, biva mu kiganza cawe, kandi vyose ni ivyawe.

Ndazi, Mana yanje, ko ugera umutima kandi ko uhimbarwa n’ubugororotsi. Ibi vyose nabitanze ata gahato kandi ndavyishakiye. Kandi nezerejwe no kubona uburyo abantu bawe bari aha bagushikaniye ata gahato.
Yewe Uhoraho , Mana ya ba sogokuru Aburahamu, Isaka na Isirayeli, zigama iki cipfuzo mu mitima y’abantu bawe ibihe bidashira, kandi imitima yabo yame ikuyoboka.

Kandi uze uhe umuhungu wanje Salomo kwitanga abikunze ngo aze afate nkama ivyo wamutegetse vyose, n’ivyo wihanikirije n’amabwirizwa yawe, kandi akore vyose ngo yubake iyi Ngoro nk’uko integuro yayo nateguye imeze.”
Maze Dawidi abwira ikoraniro ryose ati: “Muhimbaze Uhoraho Imana yanyu.” Nuko bose bahimbaza Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza; bunamira Uhoraho n’umwami.

Bukeye bashikanira Uhoraho ibimazi bamushikanira n’ibimazi vyo gutongozwa umuriro: inka igihumbi, impfizi z’intama igihumbi n’imyagazi y’intama igihumbi, hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ibinyobwa bijanye, n’ibindi bimazi vyinshi vy’Abisirayeli bose.

Kuri uwo musi bararya kandi baranywa banezerewe cane bari imbere y’ Uhoraho . Maze baca bemeza Salomo mwene Dawidi nk’umwami ubwa kabiri, bamwimikisha amavuta imbere y’ Uhoraho ngo abe umutware na Sadoki bamusiga amavuta ngo abe umuherezi.
Maze Salomo avyagira ku ntebe y’ubwami bw’ Uhoraho nk’umwami mu gishingo ca se Dawidi. Agira ikiganza ciza kandi Abisirayeli bose baramwumvira.
Abakuru bose n’abanyenkomezi, n’abahungu b’umwami Dawidi bose, basezerana kuzokwumvira umwami Salomo.
Uhoraho ashira hejuru Salomo imbere y’Abisirayeli bose kandi amuha icubahiro ubwami bwiwe buba bwiza kurusha abami bose b’Abisirayeli bamwitangiye imbere.
Dawidi mwene Isayi yari umwami w’Abisirayeli bose.
Yaganje Isirayeli imyaka mirongo ine. Yamaze imyaka indwi aba i Heburoni, iyindi mirongo itatu n’itatu aba i Yerusalemu.
Yapfuye yisaziye, yaranezererewe kuramba, ubutunzi n’icubahiro. Umuhungu wiwe Salomo amusubirira ku ngoma.
Ivyabaye ku ngoma y’umwami Dawidi, kuva mu ntango gushika kw’iherezo, vyanditswe mu gitabu ca Samweli uwerekwa, mu vyanditswe vya Natani uwavugishwa n’Imana no mu vyanditswe vya Gadi uwerekwa;
biri kumwe n’ido n’ido ry’ivyo ku ngoma yiwe n’ububasha bwiwe, n’ivyagiye biraba mu gihe ciwe hamwe n’Abisirayeli, n’ubwami bwose bwari buhakikije.
